items.text: We would like to give you advance notice of an upcoming update to our global restriction policy, which will take effect on the date below.
■ Effective Date
12.09.2026(Wed) 23:00 PST: ■ Changes
The following sanction type will be added to \[2-1] Sanction Types under “\ Sanction Types and Principles of Phased Action.”: ㄴ Leaderboard Restriction: ■ Where to find the policy
Top Menu > Customer Service > \ > \

\[General Restriction Policy] link at the bottom of our official website: The policy outlines the types of conduct that can lead to a usage restriction and how each sanction is applied.: We encourage you to review the updated policy before heading back into the field, Descendants.: We remain committed to providing a fair and enjoyable gaming environment for all Descendants.: Thank you.

Here are the details of The First Descendant Patch 1.4.7.
Descendants, please reconnect to the game for smoother gameplay.
■ Patch Date
PDT 10.29.2026(Thu) 00:00: ■ Platforms
Steam, XBOX, PS5: ■ Patch Details
(1) Gley/Ultimate Gley
Default Skills and Common Changes: ㄴ Massacre: ㆍ Removed the 20% Fire Rate Increase.

Transcendent Module: Super Senses: ㄴ Slaughter: ㆍ Removed the 20% Fire Rate Increase.: [table equalcells="1" colwidth=""]: # Designer's Comments: The Unique Weapon for "Massacre" inherits the base performance of the equipped Firearm, with its structure designed to Increase Fire Rate through Skill effects.: However, when "Massacre" is used while a Transcendent Weapon is equipped, the Fire Rate Increase effect of the Unique Weapon stacks on top of the Transcendent Weapon's already high base performance,: resulting in damage that significantly exceeds the intended balance range.: To address this, we're keeping the common standards that apply to Unique Weapons while adjusting the Fire Rate Increase effect of "Massacre" to bring the excessively high damage efficiency back in line.: This adjustment is intended to normalize the excessive performance seen in certain combinations, and we've carefully reviewed the changes to ensure that Gley's unique combat style and strengths are preserved.: We understand this change may be disappointing for those of you who have been enjoying this combination, and we sincerely appreciate your understanding.: Going forward, we will continue to closely review different pieces of equipment and skill combinations to maintain a stable and balanced experience for all players.

Here are the details of The First Descendant Patch 1.4.6.
Descendants, please reconnect to the game for smoother gameplay.
■ Patch Date
PDT 10.22.2026(Thu) 00:00: ■ Platforms
Steam, XBOX, PS5: ■ Patch Details
(1) Ultimate Gley

Transcendent Module "Demonic Modification": ㄴ Increased the fixed Fire Rate of the Unique Weapon from 120 r/min to 157 r/min.: ㄴ Decreased Explosion Damage from Skill Power x 8,942.0% to 6,259.4%.: ㄴ Increased the Damage Increase on True Aim for Explosion Damage from 44.2% to 92.1% per 0.1s.: ㄴ Improved the skill tooltip to more clearly display the Damage Increase effect based on True Aim.: ㆍ Changed the "Focus Additional Damage" entry to "Damage Increase on True Aim.": ㆍ The Damage Increase on True Aim for Normal Damage and Explosion Damage is now displayed separately.: ㆍ Removed the "Fire Rate 50%" entry, which was not applied, from the skill tooltip.
Transcendent Module "Explosive Life": ㄴ Increased the maximum number of Life Spheres that can be generated from 10 to 20.: (2) Freyna/Ultimate Freyna
Common: ㄴ All of Freyna/Ultimate Freyna's "Toxic Puddles" and "Toxic Swamps" can now reapply "Room 0 Trauma" to targets whose "Immunity" granted by "Catalyst Zone" has been removed.

Default Skills: ㄴ Contagion Links: ㆍ Continuous Damage of Toxic Reaction: Skill Power x 256.3% → 512.6%: ㄴ Venom Trauma: ㆍ Continuous Damage of Panic: Skill Power x 335.2% → 670.4%: ㄴ Putrid Venom: ㆍ Continuous Damage of Decay: Skill Power x 335.2% → 670.4%: ㄴ Venom Baptism: ㆍ Continuous Damage of Nightmare: Skill Power x 335.2% → 670.4%

Transcendent Module "Venom Synthesis": ㄴ Defense Mechanism: ㆍ Continuous Damage of Despair: Skill Power x 335.2% → 670.4%: ㄴ Venom Synthesis: ㆍ Continuous Damage of Decay: Skill Power x 335.2% → 670.4%

Transcendent Module "Neurotoxin Synthesis": ㄴ Venom Veil: ㆍ Toxic Haze can now apply Room 0 Trauma to enemies.: ㆍ Continuous Damage of Panic: Skill Power x 335.2% → 670.4%: ㄴ Putrid Venom: ㆍ The following features of Deterioration now also apply to the Hypersensitivity effect.: ㆍ Applies additional Skill Damage when attacking with the Unique Weapon: ㆍ Prevents Rounds from being consumed for a certain period of time after defeating a target afflicted with Hypersensitivity: ㆍ Decreases the Movement Speed of targets afflicted with Hypersensitivity: ㄴ Venom Baptism: ㆍ When an explosion is triggered by defeating a target afflicted with Hypersensitivity using the Unique Weapon, it now applies Room 0 Trauma to enemies within 5 m.: ㆍ Continuous Damage of Nightmare: Skill Power x 1,564.8% → 3,129.6%

Transcendent Module "Venom Injection": ㄴ Contagion Links: ㆍ Continuous Damage of Toxic Reaction: Skill Power x 256.3% → 512.6%: ㄴ Venom Trauma: ㆍ Continuous Damage of Panic: Skill Power x 335.2% → 670.4%: ㄴ Putrid Venom: ㆍ Continuous Damage of Decay: Skill Power x 335.2% → 670.4%: ㄴ Venom Baptism: ㆍ Continuous Damage of Nightmare: Skill Power x 335.2% → 670.4%
(1) Content

Cradle of Evolution: ㄴ Increased monster spawn speed slightly in Cradle of Evolution and adjusted some monster spawn locations.: ㄴ Changed some ranged monsters to melee monsters.: ㄴ If the target number of essence extractions has not been reached when a Combat Zone ends, a portal now appears, allowing players to move directly to the next Combat Zone.: ㄴ Increased the number of Phase-Tuned Crystals obtainable by defeating a Commander in Cradle of Evolution.: [table equalcells="1" colwidth=","][p align="center"]Previous: [p align="center"]Changed: [p align="center"]- Can obtain between 4 and 6: [p align="center"]- A chance to obtain between 14 and 16: [p align="center"]- Can obtain between 5 and 7: [p align="center"]- A chance to obtain between 17 and 22
Trials: ㄴ Improved "Trials" so that combat difficulty is adjusted to the new number of Squad members when the Squad size changes during a run.: (2) Equipment & Modules
Changed the cooldown of the "Prepping in the Dark" Trigger Module from 18s to 0s.: ㄴ Removed "Cooldown" from the Basic Info of "Prepping in the Dark.": (3) UI & UX
Adjusted the HUD display position of the Lucky item acquisition animation.: (4) Miscellaneous
Improved the statistics feature of the Trade Market on the official website.: ㄴ Added Transcendent Weapon statistics.: ㄴ Lounge storage trade history is now included in the statistics.
(1) Descendants

Gley/Ultimate Gley: ㄴ Fixed an issue where Focus Additional Damage was not applied correctly when equipping the Demonic Modification Transcendent Module on Ultimate Gley.: ㄴ Fixed an issue where the Maximize Lethality buff name was displayed incorrectly when using the Increased Sensory skill while Frenzied with the Explosive Life Transcendent Module equipped on Ultimate Gley.
Enzo: ㄴ Fixed an issue where the Bombing Enhancement buff name was displayed incorrectly when using the Explosive Drone skill with the Focus Fire Transcendent Module equipped on Enzo.

Freyna/Ultimate Freyna: ㄴ Fixed an issue where the "DEF Increase" effect of some Freyna/Ultimate Freyna skills was incorrectly displayed as "Skill Duration Increase.": ㄴ Fixed an issue where the DEF Increase effect of the Toxic Trigger skill was not applied when equipping the Toxic Mixture Transcendent Module on Freyna/Ultimate Freyna.: ㄴ Fixed an issue where the Stealth effect animation triggered by Freyna/Ultimate Freyna skills was not visible to allies.: ㄴ Fixed an issue where damage from Panic, Despair, Decay, Nightmare, and Toxic Reaction inflicted by Room 0 Trauma through Freyna/Ultimate Freyna's skills was applied twice.: (2) Equipment & Modules

Fixed an issue where icons were not displayed in the item description of the "Prepping in the Dark" Trigger Module.
Fixed an issue where a gap appeared at the attachment points of Handguns and Hand Cannons when male Descendants equipped the "Back Alleys of Albion," "Iron Admiral," or "Nightfall" skins.

A new Event Pass, the Halloween Pass, has been added.: ㄴ Available from after the 10.15.2026 (Thu) update PDT to 11.16.2026 (Mon) 22:59 PST
The Halloween Pass is displayed in the "Event Pass" menu in the bottom-right corner of the Battle Pass screen.

Halloween Pass can be purchased with \[Premium Upgrade] and \[Premium Upgrade + Level Included] by spending Caliber.: ㄴ You can complete missions and earn Halloween Pass EXP even without purchasing the Halloween Pass.: ㄴ Even without purchasing the Halloween Pass, you can still acquire free rewards for select levels.
The max level of the Halloween Pass is 30 and it can be purchased with Caliber.

New "Halloween Pass" achievements have been added.: ㄴ Halloween Pass achievements can be found in the "Halloween Pass Challenge" tab on the Battle Pass Challenge screen.: ㄴ Achievements consist of One-time Challenges and Progressive Challenges.: ㄴ All missions provide the same amount of EXP as a reward.: ㄴ All missions are unlocked from the start. They do not refresh or update daily or weekly.: ㄴ You can reach the max level without completing all missions.

Four Halloween Pass Missions have been displayed in \[Game Menu] - \[Challenge Objective] by default.: ㄴ Halloween Pass Missions are marked with a pink "E.": ㄴ Halloween Pass Missions can also be registered as high priority.

Halloween Pass rewards include the Little Red Riding Hood Costume, Big Bad Wolf Mask, and more.: ㄴ Depending on service availability and regulations in some countries, certain products may appear as different items.

Core rewards have been adjusted in some content.: ㄴ The content affected is as follows.: ㆍ Infiltration Operation: Hard (400% multiplier): ㆍ Sigma Sector Dropoff Operation (Normal Difficulty): ㆍ Sigma Sector Dropoff Operation (High-risk Difficulty): ㆍ Axion Plains: ㄴ The reward adjustments are as follows.: ㆍ If a Core is included in the Mission Completion Reward, that Core reward has been moved to the drop rewards.: ㆍ The tier of Cores dropped when defeating monsters has been upgraded, and the number of drops decreased.

A recommended Arche Activity value has been added to Field Missions.: ㄴ Ingris Field (Hard Difficulty): ㄴ Axion Plains: ㄴ The recommended Arche Activity for Field Missions is displayed in place of the monster level.

The acquisition chance for Transcendent Weapons at the "Ship Boarding Point" has been increased.: ㄴ Normal Difficulty: ㆍ The acquisition chance for Transcendent Weapons when defeating Normal, Elite, and Commanders will increase slightly.: ㆍ The acquisition chance for Transcendent Weapons upon Mission Completion will increase from 14.5% to 15.2%.: ㄴ Hard Difficulty: ㆍ The acquisition chance for Transcendent Weapons when defeating Normal, Elite, and Commanders will increase slightly.: ㆍ The acquisition chance for Transcendent Weapons upon Mission Completion will increase from 14.5% to 16.9%.

Rewards for "Void Erosion Purge: Normal" has been improved.: ㄴ When defeating Normal and Elite monsters: ㆍ The tier of dropped Weapon Cores has been upgraded, and the number of drops decreased.: ㄴ When defeating Commanders: ㆍ You can additionally acquire External Component Cores.: ㆍ You can additionally acquire Kuiper Shards.: ㆍ At a low chance, you can additionally obtain 1 of 42 Trigger Modules.: ㄴ Upon mission completion: ㆍ You can additionally acquire External Component Cores.

items.text: [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42627465/ccc56a34769d1c866a9af084112ea0ce44b8a0b0.png"]
Greetings, Descendants!
We sincerely thank all Descendants who joined us for the October Developer Note video.
During this broadcast, we introduced the major content scheduled for the October 15th (Thu) update.

We covered the Freyna rebalance, new Trigger Module, Gley & Enzo rebalance, update for Trials, Onslaught Stage 5, new Transcendent Weapon Monster Hunter, Transcendent Weapon Rotation Boost, Transcendent Weapon Retirement & Rerun system, melee weapon attack speed compression, QoL improvements, Cosmetics, and October events.
For more details, please check our YouTube channel.
※ Some content revealed during the broadcast may be subject to change upon actual release.
Karel's Mothership Conquest event Phase 2 will conclude alongside the October 15th update.
After the event ends, rewards will be distributed and a space celebrating our honorable Descendants will be set up on the official website.
[img src="https://dszw1qtcnsa5e.cloudfront.net/community/20261013/63c940f0-9a38-490e-8ade-c8d8340415d2/image2026101313423737.png"]
Skill 2 changes: Grants Concealment immediately on use and creates a Catalyst Zone centered on the player. The Catalyst Zone deals additional damage to enemies afflicted with Room 0 Trauma.
Skill 4 duration removed: Can be used flexibly until the magazine hits zero.
MP-proportional damage added to all skills. Maximum damage is applied upon reaching 645 MP.
Synchronization Value: Adjusted slightly down to 1.602. This accounts for increased skill power coefficients and the higher base power overall.

Toxic Stimulation
Using Skill 2 grants the Catalyst Zone to allies as well. A module that turns allies into mobile turrets that amplify Room 0 Trauma.
[td colwidth="132"]
Toxic Mixture
Firearm-related effects have been removed. Converted into a pure skill DPS module that amplifies damage through Necrosis stacks.
[td colwidth="132"]
Neurotoxin Synthesis

The module with the most changes. Skill 1 pushes enemies back and creates Toxic Haze, granting Concealment inside its range. Skill 3 applies the Hypersensitivity state. Defeating Hypersensitive enemies with the Skill 4 Unique Weapon scatters fragments dealing additional damage, and temporarily stops Unique Weapon ammo consumption.

Players can check which content which has the Transcendent Weapon boost applied via the 'Content with Ongoing Events' menu on the map.
The boosted content changes daily and is applied simultaneously to higher-tier and lower-tier content.
Boost effect: +15% increase over existing drop rates (applied as a separate multiplier, not additive). Applies to Battle Pass effects, boost items, and External Component options.
The Transcendent Weapon drop rate for Karel's Mothership is being increased.
Starting October 15th, a challenge event for participating in rotation boost content will run alongside the boost.
[img src="https://dszw1qtcnsa5e.cloudfront.net/community/20261013/b8b95618-0dec-40c8-b60d-32f4a69d55be/image2026101313423743.png"]
Application date: Scheduled to take effect starting with the November update.
The drop pool is fixed at 12. One new Transcendent Weapon will be added each month. When a 13th weapon is added, one existing weapon will retire.
Retired weapons: Weapons already obtained can still be used and traded. Only new drops are stopped.
A replacement weapon serving the same role as the retired weapon is planned for addition.
Re-runs planned on an irregular schedule. Re-runs will use a separate new system; additional details will be provided at the time of launch.
Weapons scheduled for retirement will be announced 1 month in advance.
November schedule: New Transcendent version of EXCAVA added; Malicious Dominator retires.
This update narrows the gap between minimum and maximum attack speed values.
Base melee attack speed before builds is increased, and the value gained from modules is reduced. Final speed after builds remains the same.
Normal attack motions for existing weapons are also being improved.
[img src="https://dszw1qtcnsa5e.cloudfront.net/community/20261013/6c869002-cfcc-409d-bce9-dad623b0e1b6/image2026101313423744.png"]
Save Control Options to a Loadout: Keyboard, mouse, and controller settings can now be saved as loadouts per Descendant and recalled at any time.
Including loadouts in presets will be added in a future update after additional improvements.
Hammer & Anvil - Default Improved: Descendant Enzo's Hammer and Anvil default mode is changed to Anvil Mode.
Improved Item Acquisition Effect: High-value items such as Transcendent Weapons are now shown separately in a fixed position on screen when obtained.
Changed Mission Difficulty Display: Monster levels in Field Missions are replaced with Arche Activity values.
Search Feature Added to Select Box: A search function has been added to Ancestors Module and Trigger Module Selection Boxes.
Transcendent Weapon Indicator in Library: Transcendent Weapons are now included in the Library.
Monster Invincibility State Indicator: Improved to make invulnerable states more clearly identifiable.

Added a new content, "Cradle of Evolution.": ㄴ Unlocks after reaching Mastery Rank 18 and can be accessed via the "Tactical Transport Control" NPC in Albion or through the World Map.: ㄴ "Public Operations" can be started once the required Arche Activity reaches 81,580.: ㄴ "Private Operations" can still be started even if your Arche Activity is below the required level.
Each time you enter the Cradle of Evolution dungeon, you will start from a random location, and your route will change depending on your starting position.
The Cradle of Evolution is divided into a total of 8 Combat Zones. Completing 4 of these Combat Zones allows you to move to the area where the Commander is located.

2 new types of mechanics have been added to the Cradle of Evolution.: ㄴ These mechanics appear in extermination-based battles and can be engaged in the following ways.: Vulgus Bombardment: ㆍ During Vulgus Bombardment, portals are generated throughout the Combat Zone at a certain point during combat, and Vulgus Shells spawn through these portals.: ㆍ Vulgus Shells can be destroyed using Exclusive Weapons, Firearms, or Melee Weapons, but cannot be destroyed by Skill Attacks.: ㆍ Destroying Vulgus Shells increases the Extermination Target count.: ㆍ Vulgus Shells gradually move upward, and when they reach a certain height, they explode and disappear.: Accelerate Extraction: ㆍ During Accelerate Extraction, the Energy Condensers placed in the Combat Zone activate at a certain point during combat.: ㆍ Striking an Energy Condenser after it has been activated allows you to change the direction of the laser fired from it.: ㆍ When all Energy Condensers' lasers are aimed at the central Essence Extractor, all spawned monsters are defeated.
The Commander "Separated Tarvos" appears.
(Added) DMG dealt with the Exclusive Weapon is increased, no Ammo is consumed, and Custom Resource consumption is reduced by 90%.
(Added) Defeating a monster with the Exclusive Weapon increases the mission Extermination count by 3 per kill.

(4.36% chance to acquire): ㄴ Amorphous Material Pattern: Ultimate Hailey (25.7% chance to acquire): ㄴ 2 Ultimate Hailey exclusive Transcendent Modules (17.1% chance to acquire): ㄴ 39x Collectible Coin: ㄴ Ancestors Module Loot (8.6% chance to acquire): ㄴ 9x Superconductive Cooling Unit: ㄴ Rare Alignment Device (8.6% chance to acquire): ㄴ Trigger Module Loot L (8.6% chance to acquire): ㆍ Each Trigger Module Loot L allows you to acquire one of three Trigger Modules.: ㆍ Added a new Trigger Module, "Freezing Breakthrough," to Trigger Module Loot L.: ㄴ 26x Archive Shard

Lounge Storage Trade is an asynchronous trading feature that allows other players to visit your Lounge and purchase items you have listed.

Lounge Storage Trade becomes available after completing the Sub Quest .: ㄴ Reach Mastery Rank 15.: ㄴ Complete the Sub Quest to unlock the One-on-One Trading feature.: ㄴ Complete the Sub Quest to unlock the feature for visiting other Lounges.: ㄴ Complete the Sub Quest to unlock the Lounge Storage Trade feature.
Using Lounge Storage Trade: ㄴ You can access the Item Sales screen through Guide located in your Lounge.: ㄴ You can visit another player's Lounge and access the Purchase Item screen through Guide.
Tradeable Items: ㄴ Trigger Modules, Ancestors Modules, Transcendent Weapons

Listing Items: ㄴ Trade Storage: ㆍ Items can be listed up to the number of available Trade Storage Slots.: ㆍ Trade Storage Slots can be expanded by paying a fee.: ㄴ Listing Count: ㆍ There is a daily limit on the number of items that can be listed.: ㆍ The Listing Count increases as your Mastery Rank increases.: ㆍ The Listing Count resets daily at 00:00 PDT.: ㄴ Listing an Item: ㆍ Items can be listed when there is space in the Trade Storage and the Listing Count has not been reached.: ㄴ Item Listing Restrictions: ㆍ Items in storage or currently equipped cannot be listed.: ㆍ A Transcendent Weapon under Trade Protection can be listed once the Trade Protection period ends.: ㆍ A bound Transcendent Weapon can be listed after being unbound.: ㄴ Canceling Item Listings: ㆍ Canceling a listing will not refund the Listing Count.: ㆍ Canceled items will be moved to your Inventory. If your Inventory is full, you cannot cancel the listing.

Item Purchase: ㄴ Purchase Limit: ㆍ There is a daily limit on the number of items you can purchase.: ㆍ The Purchase Limit increases as your Mastery Rank increases.: ㆍ The Purchase Limit resets daily at 00:00 PDT.: ㄴ Purchasing Items: ㆍ You can purchase an item by paying the purchase cost to the seller.: ㆍ Purchasing an item consumes 1 use of the Purchase Limit.: ㆍ Purchased items will be moved to your Inventory. If your Inventory is full, you cannot make a purchase.: ㆍ Once an item has been purchased, the purchase cannot be canceled.

Acquiring Sales Proceeds: ㄴ The purchase cost paid by the buyer is stored in the Trade Storage.: ㄴ Sellers can return to their own Lounge to acquire their Sales Proceeds.: ㄴ A Trade Fee of 10% is applied when acquiring your Sales Proceeds.: ㄴ Listed items continue to occupy a slot even after being sold, until the Sales Proceeds are collected.

If you move to another map without picking up a dropped Transcendent Weapon, it will now be sent to Lost and Found.: ㄴ Please note that if Lost and Found is full, older items will be deleted first. Be sure to claim your items before they are removed.: (2) Onslaught Desertion Penalty
The penalty system for repeated Desertion in Onslaught will be changed as follows.

Desertion Criteria: ㄴ If you are the first to leave a Public Matchmaking Onslaught while with players who are not in your Party, it will be classified as a Desertion.: ㆍ In matches with 2 to 4 players, the Desertion count accumulates for the first player to leave.: ㄴ If an Operation is abandoned while playing in a Party, the Desertion count only accumulates for the Party Leader.: ㄴ (#3) If the Party Leader deserts and the Operation is abandoned while in a Party, the Desertion count only accumulates for the Party Leader.

Penalty System: ㄴ A Matchmaking Delay Penalty will be applied when entering Onslaught based on the number of Desertions.: ㆍ The Matchmaking Delay duration increases based on the number of Desertions accumulated throughout the day.: ㄴ Once the Matchmaking Delay period ends, the penalty is automatically lifted and you can play normally.: ㄴ The accumulated Desertion count and any active Matchmaking Delay Penalty reset daily at 00:00 PDT.: ㄴ You cannot join a Party while a Matchmaking Delay Penalty is active.: ㄴ If a penalty is applied while you are already in a Party, you will automatically be removed from the Party.: (3) Descendant Mission Board

equalcells="1" colwidth=""]: # Designer's Comments: We have been receiving a great deal of feedback regarding the performance of Transcendent Weapons used by firearm-specialized Descendants.: We are aware of the same issues, and our internal gameplay data also confirms that, compared to Transcendent Weapons used by skill damage-focused Descendants, both the adoption rate and practical combat contribution are relatively lower.: Before making adjustments, we would like to first explain how we are analyzing the current situation and what direction we are preparing improvements in.: Transcendent Weapons used by skill damage-focused Descendants have high base amplification rates, and the way amplification is applied is also intuitive.: Simply equipping the weapon immediately increases the damage of primary skills, so the value of the weapon can be felt relatively easily even before additional setups are completed.: On the other hand, Transcendent Weapons used by firearm-specialized Descendants are designed so that Transcendent effects are triggered or maintained in conjunction with shooting, since shooting itself is the primary source of damage.: In this process, there are structures that require fulfilling specific conditions or repeating certain actions to maintain effects, and they were designed to achieve their intended performance only when modules, sub-abilities, and Descendant setups are sufficiently prepared.: However, aside from this design intent, we clearly recognize that the current performance of Transcendent Weapons used by firearm-specialized Descendants is not meeting expectations.: Accordingly, we are preparing an overall buff for these weapons.: In addition to simple numerical adjustments, we are reviewing improvements that allow effects to be more reliably activated during actual combat flow, as well as reducing the conditions and operational burden required to maintain effects, thereby improving usability.: We will provide detailed information on the specific targets and adjustments as soon as preparations are complete.: Furthermore, even after the changes are applied, we will continuously monitor actual gameplay data and feedback from Descendants to closely examine whether the intended level of performance is being achieved across various combat environments, including high-level content.: If we determine that further adjustments are needed, we will respond swiftly.: (1) Content

As a result, some environments may feel a reduced sense of area control compared to before. However, at the same time, stacked effects will be applied more stably and consistently.: Additionally, during the review of the bug fix, we identified that due to the nature of "Raven's Claw" being an area-of-effect skill that controls a wide range, maintaining a large number of "Raven's Claw" simultaneously—even after the expiration conditions were normalized—could result in area control exceeding the intended level.: Accordingly, we have added a limit to the maximum number of "Raven's Claw" that can be maintained simultaneously, so that performance remains within a more appropriate range while preserving the combat concept pursued by "Nightfall.": We are well aware that many players have been building their Descendants, equipment, and builds based on the current Skill behavior since Raven's launch.: Since these changes may alter certain playstyles, we will continue to monitor actual play data and closely track Raven's performance after the patch.: We will continue to monitor whether Raven maintains the intended level of performance across various combat environments, including high-tier content. items.text: Added a Mega Dungeon "Karel's Mothership" where the final battle against Karel takes place.
Vulgus General Karel will appear in "Karel's Mothership."
Vulgus of all legions will appear in "Karel's Mothership."

Three Commanders that represent the Legions appear in "Karel's Mothership.": ㄴ Commanders have enhanced battle power with new skills.: ㄴ Prepare for the Commanders' new skills to turn the tide of the battle in your favor.: ㆍ Order of Truth: "Torisar the Curse-Spreader": ㆍ Legion of Immortality: "Pattern-Enhanced Arche Slayer": ㆍ Legion of Darkness: "Reborn Alzaroke": ㄴ The Descendant who defeats Commander "Torisar the Curse-Spreader" and "Reborn Alzaroke" will gain a special ability that lasts for a period of time.

Two new Champion effects appear in "Karel's Mothership.": ㄴ Electric/Toxic/Fire/Chill Vulnerability: ㆍ Champions with Vulnerability effects for each attribute and nearby Vulgus have increased DEF against all attributes other than their vulnerability.: ㆍ Attacking a Champion after inflicting an attribute-appropriate effect can remove the Champion's effect.: ㆍ Once the Champion's effect is removed, the Champion and nearby Vulgus' Attribute DEF decrease.: ㄴ Explosive Marker: ㆍ After the Explosive Marker activates, deals Explosion Damage in a half-moon shaped range for a certain period of time.: ㆍ Explosion Damage is not dealt within a certain radius of the center of the Explosive Marker.
Weak Point Damage Adjustment Value is not applied to monsters in Karel's Mothership.

Karel's Mothership features a new Vulgus Enhancement Device.: ㄴ Propagate Nexus: ㆍ Karel's Special Energy Wave enhances Vulgus' DEF and grants Tow Immunity.: ㆍ Destroy the device that generates Special Energy Wave to remove Vulgus Enhancement Effect.

Attack the Weak Point of some structures of "Karel's Mothership" to deal powerful AoE Explosion Damage.: ㄴ Lure Vulgus near the structures and destroy them to deal powerful damage at once within a certain range.

Karel's Mothership offers Normal and Hard difficulties by default, along with a Conquest difficulty that runs for a limited time only.: ㄴ Normal Difficulty: ㆍ Complete the Main Quest to enter.: ㄴ Hard Difficulty: ㆍ Complete Karel's Mothership Normal Difficulty 1 time to enter.: ㆍ Public Operations can be started once the required Arche Activity reaches 81,580.: ㆍ Private Operations can still be started even if your Arche Activity is below the required level.: ㄴ Conquest Difficulty: ㆍ Conquest difficulty is offered as limited-time event content, not as permanently available content.: ㆍ It is a higher difficulty than Normal and Hard, and you can enter it after completing 'Karel's Mothership' on Normal difficulty once.: ㆍ This Conquest difficulty runs from after the 09.03.2026 (Thu) 00:00 patch until before the 10.14.2026 (Wed) 22:00 PDT.: ㆍ For details on the Conquest difficulty's opening schedule, event participation rules, and rewards, please refer to the separate notice. \[Go to Notice]

Added new content "Trials," where you can repeat Battle Simulations.: (1) Content Introduction
"Trials" is a re-playable battle content that incorporates rogue-lite elements.
A Round of "Trials" begins when the Mission starts and ends when the Commander is defeated, and the difficulty increases as you repeat each round.
If you select Continue, the next round begins and you will face even more enhanced enemies. Select Escape to forfeit the mission.
A portal appears once you complete the zone in the round, and you can move to the next Combat Area through it.
Combat Zones are randomly connected through the portal, so you can experience different routes with each play.
Combine "Variable Codes" selected in combat to enhance your battle power.
Depending on the traits of the 'Variable Code' selected during combat, the chance of 'Variable Codes' with similar traits appearing increases.
When completing a zone, "Variable Code" options are presented. The selected Variable Code effect is carried into the next rounds.
After defeating the Commander, you can choose to continue to the next round or escape the Trials.

Additional Damage dealt by this transcendent effect does not affect other skill effects.: [table equalcells="1" colwidth=""]: # Designer's Comments: Transcendent Weapons are a newly designed weapon system created to provide a growth experience and progression goals different from those of Ultimate Weapons.: Rather than simply extending existing Ultimate Weapons to a higher tier, they were developed with the goal of offering new options suited to each Descendant's combat style through various combinations of Transcendent Abilities.: Here is what the development team is currently preparing and reviewing regarding the Transcendent Weapon update.: 1. Regarding the transfer of Ultimate Weapon Core effects
Effects that triggered when an Ultimate Weapon Core was equipped—such as Sprint Speed increase and reduced Grappling Hook charge time—are not carried over as-is to Transcendent Weapons.

We intend to reorganize the Sprint Speed increase effect in a direction that strengthens the individuality of each Transcendent Weapon, while Grappling Hook–related effects will be addressed through long-term system improvements in an area separate from Transcendent Weapon performance.
However, as these improvements will take time to implement, we first plan to add benefits related to Sprint Speed and Grappling Hook charge time to Inversion Reinforcement.
We will update this feature as soon as it is ready after the Update 1.4.0.: 2. Improving how Transcendent Weapon stats are reflected for Descendants with skill tags
For some Descendants, we are reviewing improvements so that skill-tag skills sufficiently reflect the performance gains from Transcendent Weapon growth.

For skill-damage-based Exclusive Weapons, we are considering reflecting specific Transcendent Weapon effects into their stats; for firearm-damage-based Exclusive Weapons, we are considering reflecting the Transcendent Weapon's Attack and quality effects.

Through this, we plan to make improvements so that the value of Transcendent Weapon progression is delivered more evenly to a variety of Descendants.: We will continue to develop Transcendent Weapons so they can serve as a new progression goal and a foundation for diverse build research for all Descendants.: We will also continually check whether the base performance and Transcendent Abilities of Transcendent Weapons are being used as intended, and review balance adjustments where necessary.

Balance improvements for Onslaught Mode: ㄴ Onslaught: Stage 1: ㆍ Lowered Monster HP and Shield.: ㆍ Removed some of the Enhanced Effects.: ㆍ Removed "Legion Recovery.": ㆍ Removed "Multi-Phase Shield Drone.": ㆍ Increased Dimensional Energy value from 50 → 100.: ㄴ Onslaught: Stage 2: ㆍ Lowered Monster HP and Shield.: ㄴ Onslaught: Stage 3: ㆍ Lowered Monster HP and Shield.: ㄴ Onslaught: Stage 4: ㆍ Lowered Monster HP and Shield.: ㆍ Removed and modified some of the Enhanced Effects that appear.: ㆍ Removed "Survival Activities.": ㆍ Added "Legion Recovery.": ㆍ Reduced the number of Tyrant Spawns.: ㆍ Max Number of Spawns: 6 → 3: ㆍ Defeating Tyrants increases the target Monster Defeat Count Points.: ㆍ Previous target Monster Defeat Count: 1: ㆍ New target Monster Defeat Count: 35: ㆍ Increased the number of Amorphous Dimension Fragments that can be acquired by defeating Tyrants.: ㆍ Increased from 300 → 450.: ㆍ Removed Moving Battle Section that appears in combat.: ㆍ Added Commander to the second wave.: ㆍ One of the four Commanders will appear randomly.: ㆍ Corrupted Khulan: ㆍ Corrupted Goroth: ㆍ Corrupted Ledras: ㆍ Corrupted Sigvore: ㆍ Added cover in the Third Combat Area.: [table equalcells="1" colwidth=""]: # Designer's Comments: After analyzing recent data from Onslaught Mode, we found that your Arche Parameter choices have a much heavier impact on the overall gameplay experience than we initially anticipated.: We noticed a trend where some players were abandoning their runs early on, assuming that the rest of the content would be too punishing if they didn't roll their desired Arche Parameters right away.: To alleviate this pressure, we’ve buffed the appearance rates for higher-tier Arche Parameters. We’ve also tweaked the probability structure so that your chances of rolling top-tier parameters increase as you progress deeper into the selection phases. Additionally, we’ve removed some of the least popular Arche Parameters from the starting pool to make your early-game choices feel much more satisfying.: Beyond Arche Parameters, we've heard your feedback that Emergency Mission objectives could be difficult to recognize in the heat of the moment. To fix this, we’ve overhauled the mission activation icons, making your goals much more intuitive and easier to spot at a glance.: We’ve also taken another look at the overall difficulty of the mode.: Across all stages, we’ve toned down monster HP and shields, and tweaked certain enemy buffs to make encounters feel less tedious. For Stage 4 in particular, we’ve removed several frustrating elements that were interrupting the flow of combat, shifting the focus toward making late-game fights more engaging and fun.: Specifically, we've overhauled how Tyrant monsters function. Instead of just throwing crowds of them at you, we've reduced their spawn numbers while massively boosting their kill rewards and objective contribution. Our goal here is to shift the gameplay away from mindlessly hacking through endless swarms, and toward the strategic satisfaction of hunting down and prioritizing high-value targets.: (2) Void Intercept Battle: Extreme

Removed the Weak Point Damage Adjustment Value of Monsters appearing in Onslaught Mode and Bounty Operations.: [table equalcells="1" colwidth=""]: # Designer's Comments: Allow us to provide an additional explanation on the adjustment of the Weak Point Damage Adjustment Value of Monsters appearing in Onslaught Mode and Bounty Operations.: This adjustment is separate from the Skill Performance Adjustments for certain Descendants, implemented to improve the overall balance structure of battle content.: At present, The First Descendant applies additional multipliers by content to the Weak Point of Monsters.: This multiplier is stacked on top of Firearms' Weak Point Attacks, creating an excessive gap between weapons that specialize in Weak Point Attacks and those without the effect.: If this is carried over to the Transcendent Weapons that will be added in Season 4, it may intensify an imbalance in player preferences for certain weapon classes.: Therefore, our team is aiming to implement a step-by-step adjustment to the Weak Point balance.: First, in Void Intercept Battle: Extreme, where the impact of the imbalance is greatest, patch 1.4.0 will remove the Additional ATK Adjustment that was applied to Monster Weak Points, while implementing other balance adjustments.: The patch will also remove Weak Point Damage Adjustments that are applied to the units summoned by Monsters.: We will also take the same approach for Onslaught Mode and Bounty Operations.: However, as these pieces of content have relatively low reliance on firearms and the in-game impact of Weak Point Adjustment was low, patch 1.3.37 will remove Adjustment values first.: Meanwhile, firearm Weak Point Attack performance will be maintained.: This adjustment aims to remove the additional adjustments applied from the content aspect; therefore, it will not change any unique characteristics of weapons.: We expect minimal impact on your actual gameplay experiences with this adjustment.: However, we will continue to monitor relevant data after implementation and review any additional gameplay balance adjustments as needed.: With this adjustment, we will reduce player reliance on certain Weak Point Attack weapons and encourage our players to adopt a wider variety of weapons and builds in higher-level content.: Bug Fixes: (1) Descendants

# Designer's Comment

We have been consistently monitoring your feedback regarding the difficulties you are experiencing in high-difficulty co-op content, such as Onslaught Mode, due to other Descendants leaving the mission midway.
First, we would like to clarify the system that is currently in place.

Currently, if players leave during a multiplayer session and the active player count decreases, a feature is triggered where newly spawned monsters have their stats dynamically scaled to match the remaining number of players. This feature is also actively applied to Clash Mode.
However, we realize that due to a lack of clear guidance regarding this feature, many Descendants may have found it difficult to actually notice or feel these adjustments during gameplay.
We apologize for our lack of explanation on this matter. Moving forward, we plan to add clear in-game indicators so that you can easily confirm when this scaling feature is active.

That being said, we do not believe that simply adjusting monster stats based on player count fully resolves the core issue of mid-game quits in high-difficulty co-op content. In actual gameplay, a sudden drop in combatants inherently disrupts the flow of the operation and can place an undeniable extra burden on the remaining Descendants.

We view repeated mid-game quitting as a serious issue that negatively impacts the gameplay experience of other Descendants. Therefore, going beyond mere UI improvements, we are preparing separate, dedicated countermeasures to address this behavior.
We will share the exact details of these countermeasures and the update schedule through our future Patch Notes as soon as they are finalized.
We will continue to closely monitor and refine the co-op combat environment to ensure a more stable and enjoyable experience for everyone.

releases.displayName: Dev Note vol. 27 | Details Regarding the Patch on July 15th

items.text: Greetings, Descendants!
In this Dev Note, we shared information on the main content coming with the patch on July 15th(Wed).

This includes balance adjustments for Serena and Ines, Void Intercept Battle: EXTREME, Serena’s new skill modules, Blair’s balance adjustments, weapon balance adjustments for Divine Punishment and Final Masterpiece, firearm core type improvements, skill cooldown reduction along with rolling and resurrection effect improvements, new Trigger Modules, additional Onslaught Mode updates, content and system improvements, and new skins along with the events for July and August.
For more details, please check our YouTube channel.
※ Some content revealed during the Dev Note may be subject to change upon actual release.
■ Descendant Balance Adjustments: Serena · Ines

On July 15, balance adjustments for Serena and Ines will be applied. The detailed values and final changes will be shared later through the patch notes; today we'd like to explain the reasoning and direction behind these adjustments.

We consider it important to have an environment where many Descendants, each with their own strengths, can be used together across a variety of content. We want to reduce situations where players effectively have to pick a single Descendant for a specific piece of content, and these adjustments were prepared from that perspective. For both Descendants, we're keeping their core identity and strengths intact.

Serena: We're reworking the AoE additional damage structure of the 'Redemption' skill. The existing AoE additional damage will be split into 'Base Additional Damage' and 'AoE Additional Damage,' more clearly strengthening single-target firepower while stably adjusting AoE performance that could otherwise scale excessively down the line. The skill synchronization value will be raised from 0.496 to 1.177, and to make skill-focused gameplay a viable option as well, new Transcendent Modules 'Battlefield Nun' and 'Archangel' will be added.

Ines: After reviewing gameplay data since patch 1.3.32, we confirmed that Ines holds a considerable performance advantage over other top-tier Descendants in major content such as Onslaught Mode Level 3, Axion Plains, and Bounty Operations. As the power value of 'Dark Current' is producing a higher effect than intended, we will adjust the skill power damage of 'Dark Current' in patch 1.3.34. We will keep monitoring the data after the patch to make sure her performance does not drop excessively.: ■ Void Intercept Battle: Extreme (Beta)
Void Intercept Battle: Extreme is a mode that consolidates Hard Void Intercept and Void Abyss Intercept into one, launching in beta starting July 15.

To unlock Extreme, players must first defeat each of the Void Intercept Colossus. Once players meet the required Mastery Rank for each Colossus and defeat all normal Colossi in Extreme, 'Critical Point Breakthrough' opens, and from that point players can set Critical Points and take on the challenge.

Critical Points come in many forms, such as reducing the Descendant's shield or defense, increasing the Colossus's physical/attribute attack, dealing damage when using the grappling hook, or reducing movement speed. The higher the Critical Point value, the higher the farming efficiency, so players can choose their preferred balance between farming efficiency and difficulty.
Completing Extreme grants a 'Quality Certified ETA Voucher,' which can be used to purchase limited items from the season-exclusive shop.

After the July 15 beta update, Critical Point balance will be adjusted for about a month, and then Extreme will officially launch in Season 4 with improved balance. A Leaderboard will also run during this period, with various rewards. The Leaderboard ranks players by highest Critical Point value, so try challenging it with a variety of Critical Point settings.: ■ New Skill Modules for Serena

To make firearm and skill gameplay both meaningful options, two new Transcendent Modules for Serena will be added.: Category: Description: Battlefield Nun: A module specialized for using firearms on a single target while midair. Lowers AoE damage in exchange for concentrating powerful damage on a single target. Precisely hitting the same target's weak point with the 2nd skill grants 'Consecration,' which stacks up to 10 stacks. Consuming Consecration summons skill 4, 'Aurora'. The buff duration is determined by the amount of Consecration consumed, letting players deal explosive burst damage to a single target.: Archangel: A module specialized in using skills while midair. While midair, skill power and skill critical hit rate increases. Skill 1 fires projectiles in the crosshair direction, 7 by default, and up to 10 depending on the effect range — and stacks 'Holy Passion' on hitting the enemy. Skill 3 changes into a form that bombards enemies from the air while moving, and Skill 4 consumes all Holy Passion to drop projectiles, dealing range and damage proportional to the amount consumed.: ■ Monthly Balance: Blair
The Descendant for this month's monthly balance is Blair.
Along with his base skills, many modules have been reworked, allowing the Flame Zones to be used more versatilely.

Key Skill Changes Guide: Category: Description: Blaze Up: Can now be canceled, and the timing for creating Flame Zones has become slightly faster. It also creates additional Flame Zones at enemies around Blair. (As skill effect range increases, number of Flame Zones that can be created increases): Extinguish: Can use it even while using a firearm.: Burn Taste: Damage has significantly increased, and defeating an enemy reduces the cooldown of ‘Deadly Cuisine’.: Deadly Cuisine: Skill cast speed has been shortened, and the fireball projectile speed has been increased as well. The Giant fireball's damage has also been significantly increased.

Skill Module Changes: Category: Description: Flame-Grilled Special: The Incendiary Bomb module has been changed to 'Flame-Grilled Special.' For the passive, there's a portion where movement speed increases when moving toward an enemy afflicted with a burn.: Skill 2 becomes the 'Flame Man' skill. It consumes MP every second, but increases defense and HP, and grants immunity to knockback and knockdown.: Skill 3, 'Hot 'N Spicy,' attacks nearby enemies and grants Red Flavor stacks in proportion to the number of enemies hit. When a melee attack lands as a critical hit, Red Flavor stacks are consumed to trigger a skill-power-based explosion: Truly Deadly Cuisine: Incendiary Bomb can be used when 'Truly Deadly Cuisine' is equipped. The number of Flames thrown increased to 3 and the projectile creation time has been shortened.: Damage is greatly increased for Skill 4, and when Skill 4 explodes while a Flame Zone is present, Skill 4's cooldown is reduced.: Backdraft: As a passive skill, an additional reload-time modifier effect is always applied.: 'Extinguish,' has been changed to a Dimension skill, with Supply added to the skill type. Its cooldown is reduced, and when absorbing a Flame Zone, it instantly recovers the rounds of the equipped firearm.: When using a Beam Rifle, additional damage based on skill power has been added: Classic Chef: For Classic Chef, Skills 1 and 2 have been changed to Singular type, and a new Skill 3, 'Overcooked,' has been added, which creates additional explosions from Flame Zones spawned by Blair.: Killer Recipe: When using Skill 1 midair, it adds an increase to Skill Power and airtime duration.: Skill 3, 'Flare Up,' is added, Blair leaps into the air and deals powerful damage in a narrow area.: For Skill 4, 'Deadly Feast,' Blair couldn't fire projectiles at the same target. This time, it's been improved so it can be fired at the same target, being able to deal high damage to a single target.: Next-level Recipe: Damage of skill 1 and 3 have been increased.: ■ Weapon Balance Adjustments: Divine Punishment & The Final Masterpiece

Balance adjustments for Divine Punishment and The Final Masterpiece will be implemented.: Category: Description: Divine Punishment: When using a healing or charging type skill, it grants a Praise effect. While Praise is active, landing a Multi-Hit triggers Purifying Blaze on target to deal damage.: When Purifying Blaze is triggered, it grants a Warmth effect that raises all attribute resistances and increases HP and Shield Recovery Modifier: The Final Masterpiece: On hitting a normal monster, it causes a chill explosion at the hit location and applies Frostbite. on hitting an Elite or Commander, Icicles fall onto the surrounding Commander monsters. For Icicles, the more targets there are, the more the damage decreases. And hitting a weak point increases the Icicle's damage.: ■ Firearm Core Type Improvements

Core types for three firearms will be adjusted.: Weapon: Details: A-TAMS: 1 Special Core, 1 Precision Core → 2 Hit Cores: Nazeistra’s Devotion: 1 Special Core, 1 Precision Core → 1 Firepower Core, 1 Hit Core: Truly Deadly Arson: 1 Special Core → 1 Free Core: ■ Cooldown / Rolling / Resurrection Improvements: Category: Description: Cooldown: Maximum cooldown-reduction value is changing from 90% to 75%.: The final cooldown Descendants can reach will be adjusted to remain the same as before. For example, a skill that became 5 seconds after cooldown reduction is still 5 seconds.: Rolling & Resurrection effect: Rolling now has damage reduction and CC immunity effects.: After resurrecting, players will now become invincible for a certain time, with CC immunity and status related-immunity effects being applied: ■ New Trigger Modules
2 new Trigger Modules will be added.

New Trigger Modules: Category: Description: Arche Reflux: When using a Firing Enhancement skill, it grants Arche Reflux, and while having that effect, attacking a target that has taken damage from a Ground DoT type skill within certain amount of time triggers additional damage.: Arche Blaze: While using a levitation type skill, using a tracking projectile type skill triggers Additional Damage.: ■ New Difficulty & Balance Adjustments for Onslaught
Onslaught Mode Level 4 will be added, along with 12 new Arche Parameters.

The weekly bonuses are the same as level 3. However, by completing level 4, players can obtain more Gold, Superconductive Cooling Units, Kuiper Shards, EXP, and more compared to level 3, and there is a low chance of obtaining a Rare Alignment Device or Ultimate Alignment Device.: ■ QoL Improvements

Details updated for Arche Activity: Total Arche Activity, equipped weapons, and a detailed section showing the number of Arche Activity that can be increased depending on each piece of gear will be updated.
Grouped Acquisition Sources: 'Field Missions, Infiltration Operations, and Special Operations' are being grouped. Along with this, it has been improved to sort by most recently updated content.
Other QoL: Improvements related to the radio communications presentation, and more are being added.
(July 30) Additional Improvements: Trigger Module unlock requirements are being lowered: ■ July Cosmetic Updates
‘Awesome Service’ / ‘Awesome Burger’ (7/15): The female Descendant skin 'Awesome Service’ and male descendant skin ‘Awesome Burger guy’ will be added.
Sharen and Hailey’s Returning Skins (7/15): Sharen’s ‘Albion Academy Cadet’ skin and Hailey’s ‘Classic Maid’ skin will return.

previous 1.3.30 Patch Notes, 'Enhanced Resurrection' held a disproportionately high level of influence compared to other Arche Parameters, making it effectively a near-mandatory choice.: To ensure that a wider range of options could serve as meaningful choices, we temporarily removed the parameter and began reviewing directions for improvement.: Based on play data and internal testing, we concluded that 'Enhanced Resurrection' possesses structural characteristics that allow it to maintain a significantly higher level of influence over other Arche Parameters, even with numerical adjustments.: As such, we determined that rather than simple value tuning, it would be more appropriate to redistribute the role this parameter served into other forms of options.: In this update, instead of simply removing 'Enhanced Resurrection,' we have introduced 3 new Arche Parameters designed to fill the high-risk, high-reward role it previously occupied, while also rebalancing the existing Arche Parameters.: The newly added parameters are designed to give players a greater advantage in combat depending on how they choose to utilize them.: Going forward, rather than having a single parameter serve as the definitive answer, we will continue to add and improve Arche Parameters so that players can make diverse choices based on their playstyle and situation.

releases.displayName: Dev Note vol. 26 | Details Regarding the Patch on June 18th

items.text: Greetings, Descendants!

In this Dev Note, we shared information on the main content coming with the patch on June 18th(Thu). Along with skill improvements for Bunny and the EVANGELION cosmetic collaboration, we covered additional updates for Onslaught Mode, the new dungeon “Bastion of Immortality,” the new Ultimate Weapon “Shackles of Mortality,” weapon balance adjustments, the returning Void Abyss Intercept Colossus Tormentor, new Trigger Modules, the Boost Path, QoL improvements, and new skins and events for June.
For more details, please check our YouTube channel.
※ Some content revealed during the Dev Note may be subject to change upon actual release.
■ Monthly Balance: Bunny
The Descendant for this month's monthly balance is Bunny.
The existing “Maximum Power” skill is being changed into “Flash Kick,” an instant dash-type skill.
For Descendants who prefer the existing “Maximum Power” playstyle, “Maximum Power” can still be used through the “Electric Charge” module.

Key Skill Changes Guide: Category: Description: Electric Charge: Retains “Maximum Power” and adds a penetration effect. The Double Jump enhanced landing attack condition has been changed from 100 hits to a probability-based trigger, so the enhanced landing attack activates within 2–3 hits on average and 4 at most.: Electric Condense: An additional attack is added at the moment of use, allowing extra damage to be dealt even with the instant-charge and then firing it off right away.: Bionic Fuel: The unlimited “Speed of Light” powered by HP consumption is retained. Shield recovery while running and HP recovery upon using “Thrill Bombs” are integrated and added.: High-Voltage: The maximum number of attack targets is increased from 4 to 5, and attacks can now stack on the same target up to the maximum target count. Damage decrease is applied when stacking on the same target.

New Skill Modules: Category: Description: Electric Link: A new module that replaces the previous “Superconductor.” “Lightning Emission” has been changed into “Induced Electric”, where firing your weapon triggers an AoE attack centered on the enemy.: Electric Transition: An electric pulse is added to the single-target Flash Kick, granting it an AoE attack function. Instead of a cooldown, it now uses a “Spark” stack to allow consecutive use; Sparks are generated by “Thrill Bombs.”: ■ New Cosmetic Collaboration: THE FIRST DESCENDANT X EVANGELION
EVANGELION cosmetic collaboration runs from June 18 (Thu) through July 30 (Thu).
Plugsuit skins inspired by Rei, Asuka, and Mari, weapon skins, the Pen Pen attachment, social motions, and a variety of other customization items are added.
An event celebrating the collaboration begins with the release. See the Events section for more details.: ■ Additional Onslaught Mode Updates
UI color now shifts based on the Onslaught gauge value, allowing players to read the gauge state more intuitively at a glance.
Bombardment Support damage and range have been increased.
A random activation feature is being added to Emergency Missions.
Onslaught Mode Arche Parameter Changes: 3 new parameters are being added, and some existing parameters are being rebalanced.: ■ New Dungeon: Bastion of Immortality
A new infiltration dungeon, “Bastion of Immortality,” is being added to the Axion Plains.

This dungeon reveals how the Vulgus, after stealing the Void Vessel's research data and facilities, were putting them to use. The “Administrator,” loyal to Amon, the Immortal Legion Commander, appears as the final boss.
Random routes have been enhanced, so each route features a different combat space and different turrets are summoned by the commander.: ■ New Ultimate Weapon: Shackles of Mortality
“Shackles of Mortality”, a new Ultimate Weapon themed around a grim reaper, is being added.
After switching to the weapon, the first round is loaded as a “Resting Bullet” and a “Resting Bullet” fires every 4 shots thereafter.

The number of “Rest” effect stacks varies with your critical hit damage, the better your critical hit setup, the more powerful the effect.: ■ Weapon Balance Adjustments: Albion Cavalry Gun / ERASER / 4 Melee Weapons

Balance adjustments are being made to the Albion Cavalry Gun, ERASER, and four melee weapons.: Category: Description: Albion Calvary Gun: Improved to be broadly used by critical-hit firearm Descendants. A critical hit triggers a ricochet, and if that ricochet lands another critical hit, an additional ricochet is generated. Hitting an enemy with a Target applied grants critical hit chance and deals additional damage, and the Horseshoe effect increases movement speed while firing.: ERASER: The usability of the “Degrading Enzyme” mechanic is being improved. Acquiring Analyze effect is unified to 5 per enemy hit, and the Degrading Enzyme's range is expanded. Although duration is shortened, the damage interval is shorter, so damage is dealt more quickly, and the Degrading Enzyme's damage has also been increased.: Melee Weapons: Round consumption is being removed from melee weapons. Balance is being adjusted for Deus Ex Manus / Hypernova / Shadow / Crime and Punishment. Deus Ex Manus's special attack has been improved to fire in the camera direction, and Hypernova's maximum special attack gauge is increased. After removing elements such as bonus damage against specific Legion Commanders, a rebalance has been carried out and the base specs of all melee weapons have been raised. For Crime and Punishment, the range of the 7th- and 8th-hit spinning attacks has been widened to match the spin radius.: ■ Void Abyss Intercept Return - Tormentor
Tormentor returns as a Colossus in the Void Abyss Intercept, with a Challenge difficulty added.
Balance adjustments have been applied to prevent quick completions using A-Tams, bringing Tormentor in line with previously returning Colossus.
A new pattern based on a plus (+) / minus (−) polarity concept is added to the Challenge difficulty.
The Tormentor skin “Pain Giver” can be obtained again.: ■ New Trigger Modules
Two new Trigger Modules are being added.

New Trigger Modules: Category: Description: Electric Display: While maintaining an “Acceleration Enhancement”-type skill effect, a volt stacks over a set duration, and MP and rounds can be recovered based on the number of stacks.: Golden Ensemble: Increases skill power and skill range. At maximum roll, it can replace the existing range module players have been using, saving a module slot. It is especially efficient for Descendants with 3 or more “General AoE”-type skills, and pairs well with Bunny's “Electric Condense.”: ■ Boost Path
The Boost Path that ran in February is returning with a similar setup.: ■ QoL Improvements

Valby Improvements: The Grappling Hook can now be used while Skill 3 is active. An issue where the “Supply Moisture” module's Bubble kept applying damage based on the stats from the moment the skill was cast has been fixed, and the Bubble’s damage has been increased. An issue where the cooldown was not applied if specific actions such as riding the bike or parkour occurred while using Bubble has also been fixed, and the Bubble cooldown has been adjusted. Additionally, an issue where the “Tidal Wave” Transcendent Module did not reflect the Dimensional Arche modifier in the skill tooltip has been fixed.
High-Power Round Improvements: The round recovery amount when picking up a High-Power Magazine is increased, and the maximum capacity is being raised from 50 to 75 rounds.
Improvements for Dismantling Ancestors Modules: ‘Exclude from Select All’ option has been added.
Cinematic Replay: Cinematics that were previously only viewable in certain quests or fields can now all be viewed in Albion in chronological order.

HQ Orders Quest Improvements: A “Special Orders Status” UI is being added, allowing players to preview the current orders and the next 2 schedules along with their quests and rewards. When an order changes, a notification effect appears on Eckert's icon, and the quest accept and cancel buttons have been changed to physical buttons.

Chest Attachments becoming Common: The 5 chest attachments previously obtainable as Story quest rewards (such as “Old Teddy Bear” and “Old Wound”) are all being changed to shared items across Descendants.
Module Drop Rates Increased: For some modules that require new farming, the drop rate is being raised to 20%. (Please refer to the patch notes for more information on the affected modules.)

Bounty Operation Reward Adjustments: A Rare Alignment Device is being added as a Bounty Operations exclusive reward, and an Ultimate Alignment Device can also be obtained at a low rate. The Vulgus Bio Data Chip is being removed from the base farming rewards of Axion Infiltration Support, with a replacement reward provided separately, while the Vulgus Bio Data Chip drop rate in Onslaught Mode stages 1–3 is being increased.
Increased Chance of earning Cores: With the arrival of Transcendent Weapons coming in the future, improvements to Ultimate Weapon growth are being made.
MP Recovery Mechanism Change: A base MP effect is being added per Descendant, and the recovery condition in combat is being shortened from 3.5 seconds to 1 second.: ■ June Cosmetic Updates
EVANGELION Collaboration Skins (June 18): Rei/Asuka/Mari Plugsuit set, 3 weapon skins, the Pen Pen attachment, and 2 social motions are added.
Keelan Premium Skin (June 18th): A premium skin for Keelan is being added.
2026 Swimsuit Skins (July 2nd): The 2026 swimsuit skins are being added.

Valby “Sea Day” Mascot Skin / Freyna Medical Support Skin: Obtainable through events. Please check the June Events section for more details.: ■ June Events: Start Time: Event: Details: Starts 6/18: THE FIRST DESCENDANT X EVANGELION: An event celebrating the EVANGELION collaboration. Complete a variety of missions to earn NERV Tokens, which can be exchanged for collaboration items such as the Pen Pen name card and chest attachment, emotes, photo frames, stickers, and makeup inspired by Rei/Asuka/Mari.: Starts 6/18: Ultimate Weapon Upgrade Mission II: Earn additional materials and Gold by obtaining, converting and rolling options on weapon cores. New Orders become available each week from Eckert.: Starts 6/18: Sea Day with Valby: A login event celebrating Sea Day arriving in Albion. Freyna’s Medical Support skin can be obtained on Day 14, and the Valby’s Sea Day Mascot skin on Day 28. Various growth items are also included, such as Dia's Ancestors Module Selection Box, Ultimate Alignment Devices, and Superheated Materials.: Starts 6/18: Descendant's Weekend: A 2-week weekend boost event. Every weekend, a 20% boost is applied to Infiltration Operations, Sigma Sector, Special Operations, and Breach Tracking.: Starts 6/18: Accelerate Research Event: Research Acceleration is applied at 50% on weekdays and 100% on weekends.: Starts 6/18: Back to Albion: An event for returning Descendants. Rewards can be earned through activities such as completing Sigma Sector missions and Breach Tracking.: ■ 2nd Anniversary “Descendant Fest”
The 2nd Anniversary Descendant Fest broadcast will be held on our official YouTube channel at 5:00 PM PDT on Tuesday, July 1st.
The roadmap for the second half of 2026, an introduction to Season 4 content, the 2nd Anniversary story trailer, and more are scheduled to be revealed.

More information will be shared through posts, please stay tuned.: Please look forward to Bunny's skill improvements, the EVANGELION cosmetic collaboration, the additional Onslaught Mode updates, the new dungeon “Bastion of Immortality,” the new Ultimate Weapon “Shackles of Mortality,” weapon balance adjustments, and the various events and skins coming with the June 18th (Thu) update.: Thank you!

Checking Arche Activity: ㄴ You can check your Arche Activity in your Inventory.: ㆍ You can check your Descendant's Arche Activity in the Descendant UI.: ㆍ You can check your weapon's Arche Activity in the weapon tooltip or the Weapon Details UI.: ㆍ You can check your Reactor's Arche Activity in the Reactor tooltip.: ㆍ You can check your External Components' Arche Activity in the External Component tooltip.: ㆍ However, the Arche Activity of set options is directly reflected in the Total Arche Activity and cannot be checked in the tooltip.: ㆍ You can check your Fellow's Arche Activity in the Fellow UI.: ㄴ You can check the Arche Activity of your party members on the Party screen.

Use of Arche Activity: ㄴ Arche Activity is used as a mandatory entry requirement that must be met to play certain high-difficulty content.: ㆍ It is not applied as an entry requirement for every content, only selectively for certain content that requires a prior setup for the Descendant.: ㄴ You cannot start a Public Operation if the Arche Activity requirement is not met.: ㆍ When playing in a party, the Party Leader can only start a Public Operation if all party members meet the Arche Activity requirement.: ㆍ You can start a Private Operation even if the Arche Activity requirement is not met.

Arche Activity Calculation: ㄴ Total Arche Activity: ㆍ Total Arche Activity is the sum of the Arche Activity values of the Descendant, Weapon, Reactor, External Components, and Fellow in use.: ㆍ If two or more weapons are equipped, only the weapon with the highest Arche Activity is included in the Total Arche Activity calculation.: ㆍ The Arche Activity of each equipment is the sum of the Arche Activity values of the growth elements that make up that equipment.: ㄴ Descendants: ㆍ Ultimate Status: The Arche Activity of an Ultimate Descendant is higher than that of a normal Descendant.: ㆍ Descendant Level: Arche Activity increases as the level rises. It does not decrease if the level is reset due to assigning a module socket type.: ㆍ Descendant Modules: Calculation is based on normal modules, Trigger Modules, and Ancestors Modules, but skill modules and sub modules are not included.: ㆍ Normal Modules: Arche Activity increases as the enhancement level rises. All fully enhanced modules have the same Arche Activity. The type and tier of normal modules do not affect Arche Activity.: ㆍ Trigger Modules: The higher the option tier, the higher the Arche Activity. If there are two or more options, the average value is applied. The type of Trigger Modules does not affect Arche Activity.: ㆍ Ancestors Modules: All Ancestors Modules have the same Arche Activity. The type and tier of Ancestors Modules do not affect Arche Activity.: ㆍ Arche Tuning: Calculation is based solely on the cost of node activations. Mutant Cells do not affect Arche Activity.: ㆍ Inversion Reinforcements: Since these are reset every season, these are not included in the Arche Activity calculation.: ㄴ Weapons: ㆍ Weapon Tier: The higher the weapon tier, the higher the Arche Activity.: ㆍ Weapon Level: Arche Activity increases as the level rises.: ㆍ Weapon Modules: Arche Activity increases as the enhancement level rises. All fully enhanced modules have the same Arche Activity.: ㆍ Weapon Options: The higher the option tier, the higher the Arche Activity. If the option tier is lost due to a Weapon Level Transmission, Arche Activity is calculated as 0.: ㆍ Unique Abilities: Arche Activity increases as the enhancement level of the Ultimate Weapon's Unique Ability rises.: ㆍ Core Options: The higher the level of the Core used and the tier of the Core options applied, the higher the Arche Activity.: ㄴ Reactors: ㆍ Reactor Tier: The higher the Reactor tier, the higher the Arche Activity.: ㆍ Reactor Level: Arche Activity increases as the level rises.: ㆍ Enhancement Level: Arche Activity increases as the Reactor's enhancement level rises.: ㆍ Reactor Options: The higher the option tier, the higher the Arche Activity.: ㄴ External Components: ㆍ External Component Tier: Arche Activity of External Components is the same regardless of the tier.: ㆍ External Component Level: Arche Activity increases as the External Component's level rises.: ㆍ External Component Options: The higher the option tier, the higher the Arche Activity.: ㆍ Core Options: The higher the level of the Core used and the tier of the Core options applied, the higher the Arche Activity.: ㆍ Set Options: ㆍ Arche Activities of 2-piece set options and 4-piece set options are the same.: ㆍ For External Component sets without a 2-piece set option effect, the Arche Activity of the 4-piece set option effects is set to double.: ㄴ Fellows: ㆍ Fellow Tier: Fellows do not have tiers and are assigned a default Arche Activity value.: ㆍ Fellow Level: Arche Activity increases as the Fellow's level rises.: Weapon

Viessa/Ultimate Viessa: ㄴ Fixed an issue where Viessa's passive skill 'Ice Sphere' regenerates even when attacking while mounted on a vehicle.: [table equalcells="1" colwidth=""]: # Designer's Comment

Currently, when a toggle-type skill is active and the player mounts a vehicle, skill casting ends. The baseline for buff skills that grant status effects over a duration was to maintain those effects when mounting a vehicle.

However, while it was intended for buffs with granted status effects to remain active upon mounting (e.g., Bunny's ‘Lightning Emission’ skill), having new stacks of those buffs added while on a vehicle was not in line with our baseline.

In Viessa's case, continuing to attack while mounted after "Ice Sphere" has already been applied was considered normal behavior. However, we have determined that new "Ice Sphere" instances being generated again while on a vehicle is inconsistent with our baseline.

This situation had existed previously, but we have confirmed that simply moving while mounted allows players to continuously eliminate surrounding enemies, resulting in efficiency beyond our intended scope. We plan to address the related behavior to align it with our baseline. Going forward, skill behavior while mounted will be applied under the same consistent standard.: (3) Equipment & Modules

[p align="justify"]Here are the details of The First Descendant Update 1.3.25.
[p align="justify"]■ Platforms
[p align="justify"]- Steam, Xbox, PS5
[p align="justify"]■ Update 1.3.25
"Onslaught Mode (Beta)"
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42627465/95e733646caaccd55ad25888351d64a98810abd2.png"]- Content Introduction
[p align="justify"]ㄴ "Onslaught Mode" is a cooperation-based wave defense mode where you hold back advancing monsters.
[p align="justify"]ㄴ Use currency acquired during combat to place Turrets and Barricades, and enhance your battle capabilities by selecting abilities.
[p align="justify"]ㄴ Players move through 3 Combat Areas in sequence, breaking through each Wave with the goal of defeating the Colossi.
[p align="justify"]ㄴ Dimensional Energy decreases when monsters reach the target Zone, and the Mission ends immediately if Dimensional Energy is fully depleted.
[p align="justify"]ㄴ Tactical placement and decision-making determine the flow of battle.
[p align="justify"]- How It Works
[p align="justify"]ㄴ "Onslaught Mode" consists of 3 Stages in total.
[p align="justify"]ㄴ Each Stage progresses in a Wave format.
[p align="justify"]ㆍ Stage 1: 7 Waves
[p align="justify"]ㆍ Stage 2: 10 Waves
[p align="justify"]ㆍ Stage 3: 10 Waves
[p align="justify"]ㄴ After completing each Stage, you move to the next Combat Area.
[p align="justify"]ㄴ The Colossus appears in the final Stage.
[p align="justify"]- Battle Elements
[p align="justify"]ㄴ Monster Waves
[p align="justify"]ㆍ Monsters with different roles in battle appear.
[p align="justify"]ㆍ Monster threat levels increase as the Waves progress.
[p align="justify"]ㄴ Appearing Monsters
[p align="justify"]ㆍ New Tyrants "Spike Spiders," "Void Gunners," and "Resonance Wings" appear.
[p align="justify"]ㆍ Monsters with the new Champion Special Effect "Multi-Phase Shield Drone" appear.
[p align="justify"]ㆍ Commander monster skills are added based on the current Stage.
[p align="justify"]ㄴ Combat Area Movement
[p align="justify"]ㆍ After completing a specific Stage, you move to the next Combat Area.
[p align="justify"]ㄴ Defensive Structures and Resource Utilization
[p align="justify"]ㆍ Acquire currency by eliminating monsters and progressing through Waves.
[p align="justify"]ㆍ Use the acquired currency to place Turrets and Barricades.
[p align="justify"]ㄴ Defensive Structure Types
[p align="justify"]ㆍ Sentry Turret: A basic defensive turret that automatically attacks monsters.
[p align="justify"]ㆍ Disruption Wave Generator: A Support-type turret that decreases monster Movement Speed.
[p align="justify"]ㆍ Barricade: A defensive structure that draws monster attacks by inflicting Taunt.
[p align="justify"]- How to Enter
[p align="justify"]ㄴ You can enter via the Albion "Tactical Transport Control" or the World Map content menu.
[p align="justify"]ㄴ Stage 1 of "Onslaught Mode" is unlocked after reaching Mastery Rank 18.
[p align="justify"]ㆍ Stage 2: Unlocked after completing Stage 1 once.
[p align="justify"]ㆍ Stage 3: Unlocked after completing Stage 2 once.
[p align="justify"]- Rewards
[p align="justify"]ㄴ After completing the final Wave of each Stage in "Onslaught Mode," you have a chance to acquire Ancestors Module Loot at the following rates.
[p align="justify"]ㆍ Upon completing Wave 10 of each Stage: Stage 1: 17.5%, Stage 2: 30%, Stage 3: 32.5% drop chance.

[p align="justify"]ㄴ As previously announced through a notice on March 25 (Wed), we are expanding the scope of the investigation to other readjustment-related elements and are currently conducting a comprehensive review across all applicable items.
[p align="justify"]We will provide transparent updates on any confirmed issues, and details regarding resolutions, preventive measures, and compensation will be shared through a separate notice.
[table equalcells="1" colwidth=""][p align="justify"](Updated) Through this patch, we’ve adjusted the tier evaluation criteria for Ancestors Modules.
[p align="justify"]
[p align="justify"]An Ancestors Module’s tier is calculated using the following formula:
[p align="justify"]“Base Value (A) * Synchronization Value * Additional Coefficient (Number of Options & Penalty Option Status) = Final Value (B)”
[p align="justify"]The Final Value (B) is the value displayed in-game and the one applied to your Descendants.
[p align="justify"]

[p align="justify"]Previously, tiers were determined based on the Final Value (B). However, we identified that minor precision differences (such as decimal rounding) during the calculation process could sometimes lead to inconsistencies in tier results.
[p align="justify"]
[p align="justify"]To resolve this, the tier evaluation standard has been updated to use the internal Base Value (A).
[p align="justify"]With this change, cases where an Ultimate tier does not appear despite using the Ultimate Alignment Device will no longer happen.
[p align="justify"]
[p align="justify"]This update aligns with server-side logic and is intended to ensure more stable and consistent grading outcomes.
[p align="justify"]Please note that only the tier evaluation now uses Base Value (A), while actual stats are still applied based on the Final Value (B).
[p align="justify"]

[p align="justify"]However, since the Final Value (B) shown in-game is subject to rounding or truncation during both calculation and display, there may still be rare instances where identical displayed Final Values (B) result in different tiers due to slight differences in the original Base Value (A).
[p align="justify"]
[p align="justify"]We are also planning a future UI update so that the Base Value (A) can be viewed alongside the Final Value (B).
[p align="justify"]
[p align="justify"]Thank you.
