Comments: [p align="justify"]: [p align="justify"]The ‘Tactical Disruption’ Trigger Module, first revealed during the last Dev Live, has undergone mechanism optimization and additional balance adjustments during the final verification process prior to the live update.: [p align="justify"]During this final review, it was observed that if the Cooldown of Tactical Disruption was too short, gameplay tended to devolve into a repetitive pattern focused on repeatedly canceling Stealth, rather than utilizing the skill as originally intended.: [p align="justify"]To address this issue, the Developer’s Team has adjusted the Cooldown of the Tactical Disruption Trigger Module to 5 seconds.: [p align="justify"]At the same time, to preserve overall Firepower despite the reduced activation frequency, the Skill Power values have been increased compared to the Dev Live demonstration version (As shown in the last Dev Live), and these adjustments have now been finalized.: [p align="justify"]: [p align="justify"]\[Major Changes Compared to the Dev Live Demonstration Version]: [p align="justify"]Passive: Assassinator: [p align="justify"]- On Defeating Standard — Skill Power 4,600% (Dev Live ver.) → 5,050%: [p align="justify"]- Continuous Damage of electromagnetic fields (vs. Elite) — Skill Power 1,300% (Dev Live ver.) → 1,420%: [p align="justify"]: [p align="justify"]Flash Shortsword: [p align="justify"]- Damage: 1,761% (Dev Live ver.) → 2,259%: [p align="justify"]- Additional Damage to Assassination Target: 1,300% (Dev Live ver.) → 2,080%: [p align="justify"]: [p align="justify"]Transcendent Modules: [p align="justify"]- Release Cutting Force – Damage: 1,645% (Dev Live ver.) → 1,799%: [p align="justify"]- Area Suppression – Damage: 373.6% (Dev Live ver.) → 509%: [p align="justify"]- Focused Edge – Additional Damage to Assassination Target: 1,300% (Dev Live ver.) → 2,080%: [p align="justify"]: [p align="justify"]We kindly ask for your understanding regarding the changes to the gameplay experience compared to the demonstration version.: [p align="justify"]Common Changes: [p align="justify"]- Sharen's base Max HP has been increased by approximately 50%.: [p align="justify"]- Ultimate Sharen's base Max HP has been increased by approximately 70%.: [p align="justify"]- The Arche Type of the Passive Skill has been changed to Fusion.: [p align="justify"]Default Skill: [p align="justify"]Assassinator: [p align="justify"]- When attacking or defeating enemies in the Assassination Target state while in the Ambush state, additional effects are triggered based on the enemy’s tier.

notes.title: [p align="justify"]- The additional effects are as follows

items.text: [p align="justify"]ㄴ On Defeating Standard, triggers Burst DMG
[p align="justify"]ㆍ Damage: Skill Power 5,050%
[p align="justify"]ㆍ Damage Range: 8m
[p align="justify"]ㄴ On attacking an Elite enemy, generates an electromagnetic field
[p align="justify"]ㆍ Continuous Damage: Skill Power 1,420%
[p align="justify"]ㆍ Damage Interval: 0.5s
[p align="justify"]ㆍ Duration: 6s
[p align="justify"]ㄴ Additional damage when attacking Colossus, Commander, Tyrant: 50%
[p align="justify"]Cutoff Beam
[p align="justify"]- The skill has been changed to dash forward and deal damage to enemies.
[p align="justify"]- The Skill Attack Type has been changed from Normal AoE to Clash.
[p align="justify"]- Skill Cost: 20 → 15
[p align="justify"]- Damage x 2
[p align="justify"]ㄴ Skill Power x 2,681%
[p align="justify"]Active Camouflage
[p align="justify"]- Moves to the designated location and enters Active Camouflage upon use.
[p align="justify"]Shock Nuts
[p align="justify"]- Upon use, up to 3 enemies with the highest HP within the Effect Range are designated as Assassination Targets.
[p align="justify"]- When an Assassination Target dies, the effect spreads to nearby enemies.
[p align="justify"]- Skill Cost: 20 → 15
[p align="justify"]Flash Shortsword
[p align="justify"]- Damage: 289.7% → 2,259%
[p align="justify"]- Assassination target additional damage: 2,080%
[p align="justify"]Transcendent Module ‘Release Cutting Force’
[p align="justify"]Release Cutting Force
[p align="justify"]- Enemies hit by Release Cutting Force are inflicted with Negative Charge Leakage.
[p align="justify"]- Firearm Attacks against enemies affected by Negative Charge Leakage deal additional damage based on distance and remove 1 stack.
[p align="justify"]- Damage: 645.1% → 1,799%
[p align="justify"]ㄴ Damage increases by 10% for every 1m the projectile travels.
[p align="justify"]- Maximum Increase Distance: 40m
[p align="justify"]- Negative Charge Leakage
[p align="justify"]ㄴ Max Stacks: 10
[p align="justify"]ㄴ Additional Firearm Attack Damage: Damage increases by 7% for every 1m of distance to the target.
[p align="justify"]Infiltration Fire
[p align="justify"]- Active Camouflage is replaced with Infiltration Fire.
[p align="justify"]- Infiltration Fire is no longer a location-targeted skill and activates immediately upon use.
[p align="justify"]- Using Infiltration Fire automatically reloads the equipped weapon.
[p align="justify"]Transcendent Module ‘Overcharged Edge’
[p align="justify"]Overcharged Edge
[p align="justify"]- While in Active Camouflage, using Cutoff Beam or performing a melee weapon Normal Attack grants the Overcharged Edge state.
[p align="justify"]- While in the Overcharged Edge state, attacking does not break stealth. However, Shield is continuously consumed, and melee weapon Normal Attacks deal additional damage.
[p align="justify"]- Duration: 4s
[p align="justify"]- Shield Cost: 3%
[p align="justify"]- Shield Cost Interval: every 0.1s
[p align="justify"]- Trigger Condition: Max Shield x 10%
[p align="justify"]Shock Nuts
[p align="justify"]- Upon use, up to 3 enemies with the highest HP within the Effect Range are designated as Assassination Targets.
[p align="justify"]- Attacking or defeating an Assassination Target with Ambush triggers additional effects based on the enemy’s tier.
[p align="justify"]- When an Assassination Target dies, the effect spreads to nearby enemies.
[p align="justify"]- Sharen recovers Shield when an Assassination Target dies or when hitting an Assassination Target with Cutoff Beam.
[p align="justify"]ㄴ Shield Recovery: 30%
[p align="justify"]Transcendent Module ‘Void Domination’ is changed to ‘Focused Edge’.
[p align="justify"]Focused Edge
[p align="justify"]- Flash Shortsword is replaced with the Focused Edge skill.
[p align="justify"]- 1 Shortsword is charged when defeating an Assassination Target or when hitting an Assassination Target with Cutoff Beam.
[p align="justify"]- Up to 20 Shortswords can be charged.
[p align="justify"]- Focused Edge increases the number of Shortswords fired to 20 by default.
[p align="justify"]- Damage: 1,361%
[p align="justify"]- Additional Damage to Assassination Targets: 2,080%
[p align="justify"]- Enemies with Max Lock-On: 20
[p align="justify"]- Max Shortswords Fired at Lock-On Targets: 40
[p align="justify"]Transcendent Module ‘Battlesuit Melting Rounds’, ‘Ambushed’
[p align="justify"]- Base rebalance adjustments are applied in addition to the existing skills and effects of these modules.
[p align="justify"]Transcendent Module ‘Area Suppression’
[p align="justify"]- Area Suppression Damage: 373.6% → 509%
[p align="justify"](4) Synchronization Value
[p align="justify"]- Adjusted the Synchronization Values of the Descendant with improved performance.
[p align="justify"]ㄴ Sharen: 1.169 → 0.745
[p align="justify"]Events
[p align="justify"](1) Login Events
[p align="justify"]- Added a new Login Event, "\ Premium Cleaning Service Request." \[Go to Event]
[p align="justify"]ㄴ This 35-day event allows you to use Attendance Memento, which can be exchanged for past attendance rewards.
[p align="justify"]ㄴ You can acquire various items, including Bunny and Freyna's "Cleaning Service Skin Set."
[p align="justify"]ㄴ Period: After the 03.12.2026 (Thu) maintenance - 04.15.2026 (Wed) 23:59 PDT

[p align="justify"]- Added a new Event Shop, "Module Master Shop."
[p align="justify"]ㄴ You can access the new shop from NPC BB-On in Albion.
[p align="justify"]ㄴ Spend "Master Tokens" to get rewards!
[p align="justify"]ㄴ You can obtain "Master Tokens" when defeating enemies with a set chance.
[p align="justify"]ㆍ The maximum daily token acquisition count is 1,000.
[p align="justify"]ㄴ Period: After the 03.12.2026 (Thu) maintenance - 04.15.2026 (Wed) 23:59 PDT

[p align="justify"]- Added a new Event Challenge Assignment, "Silion's Module Enhancement Mission."
[p align="justify"]ㄴ Complete the Challenge and get "Master Tokens!"

[p align="justify"]Shop
[p align="justify"](1) Discount Coupon
[p align="justify"]- Added Discount Coupon feature that can be used for purchasing Caliber.
[p align="justify"]ㄴ You may use only one Discount Coupon per product.
[p align="justify"]- Coupons can be checked in the dedicated Shop Inventory (Coupon Box) located in Shop.
[p align="justify"]ㄴ In Coupon Box, you can sort the order of Coupons by their Discount amount and expiry.
[p align="justify"]- You can check the Coupon information in the tooltip of the coupons held.
[p align="justify"]ㄴ You can check the time left until the Coupon expiry.
[p align="justify"]ㆍ Unused Coupons are automatically deleted.
[p align="justify"]ㄴ You can check the minimum amount required for a Coupon.
[p align="justify"]ㆍ You can use a Coupon for purchases of Caliber above a certain amount; this condition varies by Coupon.
[p align="justify"]ㄴ You can check the category where a Coupon can be used.
[p align="justify"]ㆍ A Coupon can be used to a product in a designated category that meets the minimum price condition.
[p align="justify"]ㄴ You can see all applicable products at a glance using the Applied Products button.
[p align="justify"]- The best price with Coupon will appear in blue for each product, if you have applicable Coupons.
[p align="justify"]ㄴ The best Coupon refers to the Coupon that has the highest discount amount and the least number of days remaining until its expiry.
[p align="justify"]ㄴ "Coupon" tag will also be displayed with the discounted price.
[p align="justify"]- Added a feature that applies and changes Coupon in the Purchase Pop-up.
[p align="justify"]ㄴ The Coupon with the highest discount amount and least number of days until expiry will be automatically applied when making a purchase.
[p align="justify"]ㆍ For Consumables, the auto-applied Coupon may change depending on the number of bundles.
[p align="justify"]ㄴ You can cancel and change the automatically applied Coupon in \ - \[Change Pop-up].
[p align="justify"]ㆍ Change button will be deactivated if there are no applicable Coupons.
[p align="justify"]ㆍ Clicking an applied Coupon again and clicking Apply button will de-select the Coupon.
[p align="justify"]ㆍ Clicking another Coupon and clicking Apply button will change the Coupon.

items.text: Greetings, Descendants.
In this Dev Note, we shared information on the updates coming with the patch on February 12th.
[Summary of Dev Note Video]
■ Gley: Changes to ‘Blood and Iron’

Gley's Blood and Iron build demonstrated over 10% higher performance in end game content. Due to this, through further internal verification, the development team has determined that adjustments are necessary.

The Blood and Iron ‘Rampage’ skill power modifier will be reduced by 35%, with the range becoming 15m, and the max expandable range becoming 150%.: Skill Cost will be changed to 50, and the issue of attacking through walls will be fixed as well.
An official canceling feature has been added to ‘Rampage’, and we’ve improved the controls of ‘Rampage’ to allow rotation during skill activation.
The ability to ride the Hoverbike during ‘Rampage’ and canceling it has been removed, as it is a bug.
Overall skill effects and sound effects will be improved.: ■ Dia: Improvements to Skill & Controls
‘Glacial Clash / Glacial Breakthrough’: Increased the charge speed and reduced the ending motion delay, and also improved hit detection.
‘Ice Wall’: Extended its duration to make it easier to execute combos.
‘Frost Storm’: Usability has been improved. Reduced the ending motion delay and adjusted the skill animation to be faster.
‘Blooming Ecstasy – Frost Bloom’: ‘Frozen Spire’ moves much faster and direction can be changed with the L-stick while charging.

‘Blooming Ecstasy – Frost Bloom’, ‘Chill Brand’: Usability is improved, and the direction can be changed with the L-stick on the controller.: ■ Weapon Improvements – Eye of the Typhoon / Hammer and Anvil
Eye of the Typhoon: Increased firearm and attribute attack. The auto-targeting range will also be expanded.

Hammer and Anvil: Increased firearm and attribute attack. the activating effect has been simplified, and the overall damage of ‘Anvil mode’ has been increased.: In addition to these changes, various bug fixes will be implemented.: We sincerely apologize once again for the balance adjustments. As a token of our gratitude to all of our Descendants, we have prepared the following gifts.: Reward: Quantity: Crystallization Catalyst: 5
Reward Acquisition Period: PST 2026.02.11(Wed) 23:00 ~ 2026.03.11(Wed) 20:59

How to obtain Rewards: Can be earned through the mailbox within the game.: Additionally, we've prepared a Lunar New Year login event from Monday, February 16th to Wednesday, February 18th. Please log in daily to claim your rewards.: Thank you.

[p align="justify"](1) Dia
[p align="justify"]- The usability of Dia's "Glacial Clash" and “Snowflake Clash” skill has been improved.
[p align="justify"]ㄴ Increased the speed of Glacial Breakthrough.
[p align="justify"]ㄴ Increased the accuracy of the hit detection for the "Glacial Breakthrough" skill.

[p align="justify"]ㆍ Glacial Breakthrough: 2 × 2m → 3 × 2m
[p align="justify"]ㄴ Slightly adjusted the time window for chaining other skills or actions as a combo after Glacial Breakthrough.
[p align="justify"]- Increased the duration of Dia's "Ice Wall" effect. (5 → 10s)
[p align="justify"]ㄴ Increased the duration of the Movement Speed increase effect of "Glacial Breakthrough." (1.0 → 1.5s)
[p align="justify"]- Changed the cooldown of Dia's "Avalanche" skill. (60 → 40)
[p align="justify"]ㄴ (Updated) The improvement to the “Avalanche” skill cooldown is scheduled to be applied in Hotfix 1.3.19c Patch 1.3.20.
[p align="justify"]- The usability of Dia's "Frost Storm" skill has been improved.
[p align="justify"]ㄴ It is now possible to rotate left or right before firing a Frozen Spire.
[p align="justify"]- The Movement Speed of the Frozen Spire of the "Frost Bloom" skill of Dia's Transcendent Module "Blooming Ecstasy" has been increased.
[p align="justify"]- The usability of the Frost Bloom" skill of Dia's Transcendent Module "Blooming Ecstasy" and the "Glacial Wedge" skill of "Chill Brand" has been improved.
[p align="justify"]ㄴ It is now possible to aim using the L-stick on the controller.
[p align="justify"](2) Gley/Ultimate Gley
[p align="justify"]- Adjusted the performance of the "Rampage" skill of the Transcendent Module "Blood and Iron" and improved its functionality.
[p align="justify"]ㄴ Adjusted the consumption of the Custom Resource "Power of Life." (30 → 50)
[p align="justify"]ㄴ Skill Effects
[p align="justify"]ㆍ Damage (4969.0% → 3264.8%)
[p align="justify"]ㆍ Range (18.0m × 18.0m → 15.0m frontal area)
[p align="justify"]ㆍ Max Expandable Range (200% → 150%)
[p align="justify"]ㄴ Functional Improvements
[p align="justify"]ㆍ Modified so that the "Rampage" skill can no longer pass through walls.
[p align="justify"]ㆍ Improved so that other actions can be performed more quickly while using "Rampage."
[p align="justify"]ㆍ Modified to allow rotation while using the "Rampage" skill.
[table equalcells="1" colwidth=""][p align="justify"]# Director's Comments
[p align="justify"]Gley’s Blood and Iron build has been performing beyond its intended scope, to the extent that it could impact the gameplay experience of other Descendants in certain dungeons.
[p align="justify"]Accordingly, we have adjusted its overall performance while also implementing usability improvements to reduce inconveniences during use.
[p align="justify"]
[p align="justify"]Following this patch, we will continue to closely monitor your feedback and in-game data.

items.text: Greetings, Descendants.
This is the Director of The First Descendant, Minseok Joo.
Since the Season 3 Episode 3 update on February 5th, the dev team and I have been reviewing various feedback from the community.
We are fully aware of the disappointing aspects of the newly updated content and are preparing to make improvements through a follow-up patch.

Currently, the development team is reviewing Gley's ‘Blood and Iron’ module, which has shown performance beyond its intended scope. Along with this, we are also examining improvements to the usability of ‘Blood and Iron’ skill and the new Descendant, Dia.
Furthermore, we’re looking into performance enhancements for several weapons, such as ‘Eye of the Typhoon’ and ‘Hammer and Anvil’, as well as overall game optimization and technical issues.
These issues will be adjusted through a patch that is being prepared for this week.

We will provide more detailed information through a Dev Note video on February 11th. We’ll continue to closely monitor the gameplay experience of our Descendants and constantly strive for a better direction in the future.
We would like to inform you about the details for The First Descendant Hotfix 1.3.18b.
This patch will be applied without a client update, allowing immediate access without additional downloads.
For Descendants currently in-game, please return to the title screen and reconnect to apply the patch.

As a result, his sustained damage potential remained structurally low compared to other Descendants. We would appreciate it if this balance adjustment is understood as a preparatory step toward addressing this issue.: [p align="justify"]With this patch, Kyle’s base damage has been slightly reduced, but his damage now increases by approximately 0.4% per 100 Shield, up to a maximum of 88.4%. As a result, even with a basic module setup, an overall damage increase of more than 5% compared to previous values can be expected.: [p align="justify"]The goal of this change is to make additional DMG scaling through Shields a meaningful option worth considering when configuring Ultimate or Ancestors Modules.: [p align="justify"]We will continue to closely monitor Kyle’s performance after the patch and, through ongoing evaluation, strive to make him an even more compelling Descendant in future improvement phases.: [p align="justify"]- Reduced the damage of all skills by about 30%.: [p align="justify"]ㄴ However, skill damage increases by up to 88.4% in proportion to Max Shield.: [p align="justify"]- Transcendent Module "Superconductive Bombing MARK 2": [p align="justify"]ㄴ Superconductive Bombing MARK 2: [p align="justify"]ㆍ Increased the Fire Rate of Bombardment by about 50%.: [p align="justify"](4) Gley/Ultimate Gley: [table equalcells="1" colwidth=""][p align="justify"]# (Updated) Designer’s Comment: [p align="justify"]Greetings, Descendants. This is the Director of The First Descendant, Minseok Joo.: [p align="justify"]First, I would like to sincerely apologize for the discrepancy between Gley’s update specifications revealed in today’s patch notes and the version demonstrated during the Dev Live.: [p align="justify"]During the final stages of balance testing prior to the update, we identified that Gley was exhibiting overpowered performance. As a result, we made adjustments to some of the values that had been shown during the Dev Live.: [p align="justify"]Based on our internal evaluations, Gley demonstrated performance exceeding our expectations, with notably high sustainability and ease of use. Lock-On automatically aims at the target's Weak Point.
Attacking an enemy's Weak Point in Lock-On increases Firearm ATK and Weak Point Damage.

items.text: ㆍ (Before) Mutant Cell Box C → (After) Mutant Cell Box D
ㆍMutant Cell Box D is a box that adds one new Mutant Cell type to the existing Mutant Cell Box C.

The Quest UI now features "Quick Travel" that allows instant travel to the quest location, and "Tips" that assists with quest progression.: ㄴ These features are only available for Main Quests, Sub Quests, and Descendant Quests.

Escort missions have been improved.: ㄴ Increased the overall movement speed of drones appearing in escort missions.: ㄴ Increased the escort range of drones.: ㄴ Adjusted monster spawn timing to match the increased drone speed.
The explosion range of the following monsters is now reduced if the player defeats them before they self-destruct.: ㄴ Zealot, Trapball, Bomber, Cindermaw: (2) Weapons & Modules

The upper limit for Mastery Rank, one of the requirements for equipping Ancestors Modules, has been lowered from 30 to 25.: ㄴ If the Mastery Rank requirement for the Ancestors Modules you own is 26 or higher, it will be lowered to 25.

The maximum number of Ancestors Modules you can own has been increased.: ㄴ Increased the number of modules you can own from 70 to 90 for Mastery Ranks 1 to 10.: ㄴ When your Mastery Rank exceeds 10, the number of modules you can own increases by 3 per Mastery Rank.

Improvements have been made to the Unique Abilities of four Ultimate Weapons.: [table equalcells="1" colwidth=","][p align="center"]Ultimate Weapon: [p align="center"]Unique Ability Changes: [p align="center"]Shadow
When Shadow Dash or Shadow Slash hits, it can trigger an additional attack based on Additional Attack Chance and Additional Attack Damage.: [p align="center"]Fallen Hope
Using a Toxic skill grants Toxin Aggregation to self.: ㄴ While Toxin Aggregation is in effect, Firearm ATK and Attribute Status Effect Trigger Rate increase.
While Toxin Aggregation is in effect, using a Ground DoT type skill grants Toxin Discharge to self.: ㄴ While Toxin Discharge is in effect, Toxic Skill Power increases.

While Toxin Discharge is in effect, hitting an enemy has a chance to trigger Perdition on the target, inflicting additional damage and Poison on enemies within range.: ㄴ The additional damage from Perdition increases proportionally to the number of Poison stacks on the target and the number of your Toxin Discharge stacks.

While Toxin Discharge is in effect, defeating an enemy has a chance to trigger an explosion on the target, inflicting additional damage and Poison on enemies within range.: [p align="center"]Truly Deadly Arson
New effects have been added to the existing Unique Ability.
Using a Fire skill grants Heat Stacking.

Heat Stacking converts to Combustion when you deal damage with a Continuous Damage type skill.: ㄴ While Combustion is in effect, the power of Continuous Damage type skills increases.: [p align="center"]Hive Master
When the Shock Bug fires beams and triggers Discharges, its damage increases proportionally to the number of targets affected.

A visual effect has been added that indicates the beam firing interval reduction and the range that satisfies the Discharge triggering condition when an enemy within the range of the enemy inflicted with Attach Bug is hit.
The enemy detection range and the Discharge range around the Shock Bug Beam shots have been increased from 10m to 15m.
Improved the firing sound of Nazeistra's Devotion.
Added 11 Common Level 1 firearms for purchase through Deslin.

Improved weapon module cooldowns.: ㄴ The previous method where the cooldown for the same module was applied individually based on its Enhancement Level has been improved so that the cooldown is now shared for the same module within the same category.
Switching weapons while a Weapon Module's effects are active now removes the module's effects.: (3) Collectibles

Improved the sorting and filtering functions for Ancestors Modules dismantling and Readjustment.: ㄴ When entering the Ancestors Modules dismantling or Readjustment screen, the initial sorting is now set to Name.: ㄴ Sorting and filter settings will now be retained even after closing and re-entering the Ancestors Modules dismantling or Readjustment screen.
Modified the Synchronization Values of Descendants to display up to the third decimal place.

Added an "Unlocked Trigger Module Slot" indicator to the display information of the Descendant list.: ㄴ Descendants with the unlocked Trigger Module slot will have their existing Energy Activator icon replaced with a Trigger Module icon.
Renamed the "Applied Value" area that previously showed the effects of existing modules on the Descendant Module screen to "Existing Modules."

Added a tooltip button containing descriptions of equipment in the Inventory screen.: ㄴ Added a tooltip button containing an explanation of Weapon Proficiency in the Equip Weapon screen.: ㄴ Added tooltip buttons containing explanations of effects and upgrade methods of Reactors and External Components in the Equip Reactor and Equip External Components screens.
Added a Lounge mark to the Lounge Pose icon.
Improved visibility when inspecting Figurines, Ornaments, and Trophies placed in the Lounge.
When you select a Descendant performing a lounge pose, the Select Lounge Pose UI now displays which lounge pose is currently being performed.
Improved the display of Dioramas in the Shop Preview and Inventory Details.
The remaining days available for Void Abyss Intercept Battle: Challenge are now displayed.

Improved the "Options/Keyboard & Mouse" settings.: ㄴ The control button settings category has been subdivided.: ㆍ Movement Control Settings/When Equipped with a Ranged Weapon/When Equipped with a Melee Weapon/When Riding a Vehicle/Combat/General/Interface: ㄴ Keys used for movement controls can no longer be reassigned to other control buttons.: ㄴ Duplicate key binding while changing control settings no longer removes the previously bound key.: ㆍ A duplicated key binding notification will be displayed for the duplicate bound key.: ㆍ As duplicate key bindings can cause abnormal operations, please remove all duplicate key bindings.: ㄴ Changed the voice input button.: ㆍ (Before) B → (After) N

Improved the "Options/Controller" settings.: ㄴ The control button settings category has been subdivided.: ㆍ When Equipped with a Ranged Weapon/When Equipped with a Melee Weapon/When Riding a Vehicle/Combat/General/Interface: ㄴ Placed "Default/Left-handed/User Settings" on the main tab.: ㄴ When in 'Default/Left-handed' state, you can change the 'When Equipped with a Ranged Weapon/When Equipped with a Melee Weapon/When Riding' controls in the left sub-tab.: (6) Miscellaneous
Added support for AMD FidelityFX™ Super Resolution 4 (AMD FSR 4) on AMD Radeon™ RX 9000 series and later graphics cards.: Bug Fixes: (1) Content

Supermassive Receptor: ㄴ Fixed an issue where Razor Claws could not move on certain terrain.: ㄴ Fixed an issue where players could become stuck on moving platforms.: ㄴ Fixed an issue where the designated sound effect was not played when obtaining a large amount of materials with a low probability.
Fixed an issue where camp markers could not be selected using a gamepad while they overlapped with quest markers on the map.
Fixed the volume of monster voice reverberation to be adjusted according to the "Options/Audio/Sound Effect Options/Monsters" settings.: (2) Descendants

Luna, Ultimate Luna: ㄴ Fixed an issue where notes were not displayed when swapping Modification Modules while equipped with a Unique Weapon.: ㄴ Fixed an issue where the Inspiration Gauge for the Battlefield Artist would not be removed even when not in combat.: ㄴ Fixed the volume of Luna skill music to be adjusted according to the Options/Audio/Sound Effect Options/PC settings.
Harris: ㄴ Fixed an issue where the character would occasionally become stuck in mid-air when using the Site Intrusion or Tactical Oversight skills.: (3) Weapons & Modules
Fixed an issue where the increased damage and dash distance from charging the ultimate weapon Shadow's special attack applied before the charging animation began.
Fixed an issue where male characters using the ultimate weapon Hypernova's special attack in mid-air would be unaffected by inertia and land at the exact location of the attack.
Fixed an issue where the enhancement effect for Enzo's Firearm Enhancer would be displayed in an unintended location when the effect is obtained after holding a melee weapon.
Fixed an issue where the ultimate weapon Exterminator would not deal additional damage to some Breach Cluster Sacs in the Axion Plains.
When switching between ranged and melee weapons during firing or attack input, the attack now continues with the switched weapon.: (4) UI&UX
Updated the My Record screen on the leaderboard to no longer display My Best Time at the top.
Fixed an issue where the acquisition pop-up would immediately close when purchasing a product through the related product UI.
Fixed an issue where the locations of some monsters were occasionally not displayed on the radar.
Fixed an issue where the research duration displayed before starting research on two or more items simultaneously would differ from the actual research duration.
Fixed an issue where the Ancestors Module effect information would not update immediately after removing an equipped Ancestors Module and equipping another Ancestors Module.: (5) Miscellaneous
Fixed an issue where the enhancement values of the Reactor were being applied at double the intended amount.

Lounge: ㄴ Fixed an issue where customization changes to Descendants, Fellows, Vehicles, or Weapon Skins made in the Lounge were not immediately applied to objects placed in the Lounge.: ㄴ When both chair and bed poses are present during the Lounge Pose preview, the bed pose will now display the bed.
Fixed an issue where saved Inversion Reinforcement loadouts were not applied correctly when changing presets.: Companion App

Trigger Modules and External Component Cores can now be viewed in the TFD Companion App.: ㄴ If you are using a version below v1.0.6, these features will not appear in the \[My Info] tab. Please update to v1.0.6 or later to access them.: Thank you.

(Revised) The Ancestors Module options are determined based on set probabilitiesacquired randomly, and you can obtain up to four stats.: ㄴ (Revised) There are 4 tiers of random options, each determined based on set probabilities.: ㄴ There are Common, Rare, Ultimate, and Transcendent tiers.: ㄴ The text color of the option name and values matches the color of the acquired tier.: ㄴ (Revised) You can also check the tier of an acquired random option through the module icon.

Ancestors Modules are affected by the Descendant's Synchronization Value.: ㄴ You can view the Synchronization Value of each Descendant in the Info screen - Sub section.: ㄴ The higher the Synchronization Value, the higher the minimum and maximum option values.: • The Descendant Synchronization Value is planned to be adjusted according to the following schedule: • At the start of a new Season or Episode: Adjustments will be made only for Descendants selected through balance analysis.: • During Rework or Rebalance updates: Adjustments will apply only to Descendants undergoing rework or rebalance.: • Currently, some Descendants have Synchronization Values based on their lower-end performance.: • If a Descendant’s lower-end performance improves through a rework or rebalance, its Synchronization Value will also be adjusted to prevent excessive upper-end performance.: • When the Synchronization Value is adjusted, the performance of already-owned Ancestors Modules will be automatically updated accordingly.

Party member recommendations have been improved to prevent recommending party members who meet the following conditions: ㄴ Players currently in matchmaking or inside a dungeon: ㄴ Players already in a Party

Improved the party recruitment operation when the session is full.: [table equalcells="1" colwidth=","][p align="center"]Previous: [p align="center"]After Improvement: [p align="center"]Party recruitment stops if the session fills up during recruitment.
Party recruitment doesn't stop if the session fills up during recruitment,: and can continue even if the session is full.
If party recruitment is conducted in a full session, your Party will be shown as a Recommended Party only to players in the same session.
One new social tag has been added.: ㄴ Infiltration Operation: Hard Axion Plains: Supermassive Receptor: (6) UI & UX
Added a feature that allows you to restart through the game menu during Void Erosion Purge: Normal and Void Erosion Purge: Hard.

Lounge.: ㄴ Fixed the camera to display consistently when exiting the Lounge.: ㄴ Reduced the frequency of confirmation pop-ups when placing Collectibles in the Lounge.: ㄴ Fixed the Lounge UI to show the display status in more detail.: ㄴ Fixed the Lounge UI so it no longer responds when hovering the cursor over a selected slot.: ㄴ Added notification text related to Lounge features.

Collectibles: ㄴ Improved the Collectibles Purchase Complete pop-up so that when you acquire a Collectible you don't already own, it will be displayed as a new acquisition.: ㄴ (Updated) Improved the Collectibles Inventory, Dismantle Collectible, and View Collectibles Box Content pop-ups to allow sorting by quantity owned.

Social: ㄴ Added a "View Online Friends" button that enables sorting and viewing only friends who are currently online in Social > Friends List.: ㄴ In the Squad UI and the Descendant Details pop-up, the level of a Descendant who has used a Catalyst is now displayed in green.

Shaping Device: ㄴ Improved the guide content for shaping Amorphous Materials via the Shaping Device to provide more detailed information.: ㄴ Added a notification when all of the selected Amorphous Materials or Shape Stabilizers are consumed while shaping Amorphous Materials.

Weapons: ㄴ Improved the firearm pictograms displayed in the HUD Firearm UI from weapon type icons to individual weapon icons.: ㄴ When unlocking or equipping a Weapon Core, if the selected weapon is a melee weapon, View Chances now allows you to immediately check the option assignment chances for each Melee Weapon Core.
Inventory: ㄴ Improved the Mutant Cell Selection Box to display the number of Mutant Cells currently held inside.

Presets: ㄴ Changed the text on the Apply Preset button to Load Settings.: ㄴ Changed parts of the UI layout.: ㆍ Moved the Rename Preset button to the right of the preset name.: ㆍ Added a UI button for the Load Settings function.: ㆍ Changed the position of the Save Current Settings button.: (7) Miscellaneous
Options: ㄴ Added options to adjust the Lounge View Range and Lounge Gamepad Sensitivity.: ㄴ Removed tab names that no longer appear in the game options descriptions.
Trigger Modules: ㄴ Added a dedicated category for non-skill modules.: ㆍ Allows viewing only Trigger Modules that are not related to skill usage.

Dismantle Trigger Module: QoL feature: ㄴ Added an Unequip All feature.: ㆍ Added a feature to unequip all equipped Trigger Modules from the Descendant in use.: ㄴ Added a Select All Sub Options feature.: ㆍ Added a feature that selects all sub options after comparing option values ​​between identical modules.

Dimensional Breach Alert Contribution: ㄴ Changed the Contribution calculation method for Dimensional Breach Alerts.: ㄴ Participating in a Wall Crasher battle gives base Contribution just for participating.: ㄴ Additional Contribution is earned based on your ranking for damage dealt to the Wall Crasher.: (However, additional contribution based on ranking is not calculated in solo matchmaking battles.): ㄴ Due to changes in the contribution calculation method for Dimensional Breach Alert, all contribution records will be reset.: ㆍ We apologize for any inconvenience caused by the reset of your Dimensional Breach Stabilization Contribution, and as a token of our apology, all Descendants who log in will receive a Crystallization Catalyst.: ㆍ Please make sure to claim the reward before it expires on November 26, 2025 (Wed) 22:59 PST.: [table equalcells="1" colwidth=","][p align="center"]Mail Delivery Period: [p align="center"]Reward Item: [p align="center"]After the maintenance on November 6 ~ November 19, 2025 (Wed) 22:59 PST: [p align="center"]Crystallization Catalyst (1)
Ironheart Particles: ㄴ Reduced the Ironheart Particles obtained from the Axion Plains.: ㄴ Reduced the Ironheart Particles obtained from the Void Vessel - Medium-Sized Facility Zone.
Missions: ㄴ Fixed an issue where, after aborting the same mission four times consecutively, you would not be automatically relocated to the nearest Outpost or makeshift Safe Zone.
(Added) The English voice actor for Enzo has been changed from Shai Matheson to Jared Zeus.: Bug Fixes: (1) Descendants

Fixed an issue where the applied base Electricity gain value for Bunny and Ultimate Bunny's passive skill Rabbit Foot was lower than intended.: ㄴ Electricity Gained while Moving: 0.1% → 0.2%: (2) Weapons & Modules
Fixed an issue where the weapon would not fire after switching weapons while holding down the Fire key.
Fixed an issue where pressing the melee weapon attack key while sprinting in Albion would change the sprint to a run.: (3) Content

Fixed the UI that displayed Mission Successful when a Vulgus Strategic Outpost, Void Fragment, or Void Fusion Reactor mission was aborted to display it as failed.
Fixed an issue where the elimination target UI above monster heads was sometimes not displaying for monsters designated as mission objectives.
Fixed an issue where navigating directly to the Shop from the Login Event board to purchase Attendance Mementos would take you to a tab where the Attendance Memento was not available.
Fixed an issue where the “Instant Research” button was displayed even when the required research materials were insufficient.: (5) Miscellaneous
Fixed an issue where the Battle Pass Season Challenge “Complete Missions as a Squad” could be cleared regardless of public matchmaking or party status.

items.text: Thank you for all the interest and feedback you’ve shared regarding the trading system introduced during the recent Dev Livestream.
Based on your valuable feedback, we’ve decided to change the trade fee from Caliber to Gold.
To accommodate this adjustment, the trading system will now be released with the November 20 update.
Please check out the video below for more details.
All other updates will proceed as planned on November 6.
We’ll continue to do our best to provide a stable and enjoyable service.

Greetings, Descendants!
The October 1 (Wed) update will bring a variety of new content, including the addition of Sword weapons, along with several improvements aimed at enhancing overall gameplay convenience.
Here’s a preview of the major QoL improvements in this update, and we appreciate your continued support for the upcoming October update.
■ Major QoL Improvements
(1) Removal of Reactor Weapon Optimization Conditions
To allow for more flexible use of different weapons and improve accessibility for new players, Optimization Conditions that were only applied when equipping specific weapons will be removed.
Accordingly, the "Reactor Implant" function in the Auxiliary Workbench, related Quests, and Awards will also be removed.

Additionally, with the removal of Optimization Conditions, the Skill Power increase that previously activated when meeting these conditions will be incorporated into the Reactor's base Skill Power.: (2) Changes to Amorphous Material Opening Method
To reduce the hassle of opening Amorphous Materials, this function will be improved to allow single or continuous opening through interaction with NPCs located in Albion.
As a result, the Reconstructed Devices that were created when clearing Void Intercept Battles and Void Fusion Reactors will be removed.
Additionally, please note that the Void Intercept Battle: Hard will be revised in the future and the current content format will be maintained until then.: (3) Laboratory Improvements
The "Legion of Breach," a new legion introduced in Season 3 Axion Plains, will be added to the Laboratory Legion settings.

The maximum number of Common Monsters that can be summoned in the Laboratory will be increased to 50.: We will continue to consider and implement improvements to enhance convenience and satisfaction for our Descendants.: Thank you.

The Lounge is a place where Descendants can relax and take breaks between missions.
You can enter the Lounge in Albion.: ㄴ You can enter the Lounge by carrying out the sub quest that begins after the main quest is completed.

You can place Descendants, Fellows, Vehicles, Weapon Skins, Back Attachments, Chest Attachments, and newly added Collectible items in the Lounge.: [table equalcells="1" colwidth=","][p align="center"]Categories: [p align="center"]Text: [p align="center"]Descendants
You can place Descendants you own in the Lounge.
If you own both the Normal and Ultimate versions of a Descendant, only the Ultimate Descendant can be placed.
You can select a customization loadout to apply to Descendants placed in the Lounge.
You can approach and chat with Descendants who are not assuming Lounge Poses.: [p align="center"]Lounge Pose
Descendants placed in the Lounge will assume the Lounge Poses you own.
You can select a Lounge Pose to assume from the Place Descendant screen, and lock a Lounge Pose to repeat.: [p align="center"]Fellows
You can place Fellows you own in the Lounge.
You can select a customization loadout to apply to Fellows placed in the Lounge.: [p align="center"]Vehicle
You can place Vehicles you own in the Lounge.
Vehicles placed in the Lounge will have their Customization settings applied.: [p align="center"]Weapon Skins
You can place Weapon Skins for any weapon you've ever owned in the Lounge.
Weapon Skins placed in the Lounge will have their Paint settings applied.
Weapon Skins placed in the Lounge can be inspected up close.: [p align="center"]Chest Attachments/Back Attachments
You can place Chest Attachments/Back Attachments you own in the Lounge.
Chest Attachments/Back Attachments placed in the Lounge can be inspected up close.: [p align="center"]Lounge Collectibles (Ornaments/Trophies/Figurines/Dioramas)
You can place Ornaments/Trophies/Figurines/Dioramas you own in the Lounge.
Ornaments/Trophies/Figurines/Dioramas placed in the Lounge can be inspected up close.
You can rotate Ornaments/Trophies/Figurines to change their placement orientation.
You can place Figurines on Dioramas.

Random Placement: ㄴ When you enter the Lounge, your Descendants are randomly placed.: ㄴ When the Descendants are randomly placed, their loadouts are randomly selected and applied.: ㄴ Random Placement settings can be changed via the guide in the Lounge.
Lounge Atmosphere: ㄴ When you enter the Lounge, lighting and weather are randomly applied.: ㄴ The Lounge atmosphere can be changed via the guide in the Lounge.

Lounge Extension: ㄴ Upon reaching Mastery Rank 5, you can spend 1 million Gold to extend your Lounge by building a Bedroom.: ㄴ You can place additional Descendants, Weapon Skins, Back Attachments, Chest Attachments, Ornaments, Trophies, and Figurines in the Bedroom.: ㄴ Some Lounge Poses can only be viewed through Descendants placed in the Bedroom.

Lounge Photo Mode follows different rules from normal Photo Mode.: ㄴ Only free movement is allowed in Lounge Photo Mode.: ㄴ There is no Subject Tab in Lounge Photo Mode.: ㄴ You can save presets in Lounge Photo Mode separately from the presets saved in normal Photo Mode.: Collectibles

Collectibles are items that can be placed in the Lounge for viewing.: ㄴ Ornaments: Collectibles that become increasingly detailed as they level up.: ㄴ Figurines: Collectibles that can be placed directly in the Lounge or on Dioramas.: ㄴ Trophies: Collectibles obtained by completing Awards.: ㄴ Dioramas: Sets that serve as backdrops for placing Figurines.: ㄴ Lounge Poses: Actions that Descendants placed in the Lounge can perform.

Ornaments and Figurines can be obtained by purchasing Common or Premium Collectibles Boxes via the "Purchase Collectibles" feature from Collec-T in Albion or Edi-T in the Lounge.: ㄴ One Common Collectibles Box can be purchased with 100 Collectible Coins, and one Premium Collectibles Box can be purchased with 100 Premium Collectible Coins.

Some Ornaments, Figurines, Dioramas, and Lounge Poses can be obtained by spending Collectible Coins via the "Exchange Collectibles" feature.: ㄴ Any remaining Collectible Coins can also be exchanged for small amounts of Gold, Kuiper Shards, Quantum Incubators, or Void Abyss Metal Fragments.
Ornaments and Figurines obtained from Common and Premium Collectibles Boxes can be dismantled using the "Dismantle Collectible" feature for 25 Collectible Coins each.
Trophies can be earned by completing Intercept Battle Awards.

Collectible Coins can be earned by completing the missions below or defeating monsters.: ㄴ 400% Infiltration Operation: 12 coins: ㄴ High-risk Difficulty Sigma Sector: 20 coins: ㄴ (Normal/Operational Area) Axion Plains: 28 coins: ㄴ Hard Difficulty Void Vessel: 40 coins: ㄴ Defeating an Axion Plains Commander has a low chance to obtain 100 coins.: ㄴ Defeating the Wall Crasher guarantees 100 coins, with a low chance of obtaining an additional 1000 coins.

Skill Module 1: Battlefield Concert: ㄴ Luna mounts her Unique Weapon and attacks enemies. Provides notes that are different from normal, and Inspiration Gauge is gained by shooting and using skills.: ㄴ Using the skill grants Luna a buff, attacking an enemy while the buff is active inflicts a debuff on the enemy.: ㄴ Using the skill when the Inspiration Gauge is full activates Enhanced Skills and grants Luna the "Fever Time!" effect.: ㄴ During “Fever Time!”, all of Luna's notes are judged as Successful, her Unique Weapon's firing rate increases, and she inflicts a stronger debuff on enemies.: ㄴ While the Fan Service skill effect is active, if auto-targeting is not used when aiming, Luna fires additional shots in the direction of the crosshair.

Skill Module 2: Battlefield Artist: ㄴ Instead of using her Unique Weapon, Luna uses the firearm equipped in the slot to attack enemies.: ㄴ Using the skill grants Luna a buff, which is applied when she uses the Remix skill.: ㄴ Using Remix grants a buff to allies within range based on the color of the Inspiration Gauge.

releases.displayName: Apology and Compensation Announcement for Issues After Season 3 Update

notes.title: This is The First Descendant Producer Beom-jun Lee.

items.text: I would like to sincerely apologize for the inconvenience and disappointment you experienced due to the recurring issues during the recent Season 3 update. Through today’s announcement, I would like to address the issues related to the "Battle Pass" and "Wall Crasher" content.

First, regarding the "Battle Pass," there were continuous errors such as Weekly Challenges not refreshing and abnormal Daily Challenge EXP gains, which directly affected our Descendants' achievements and rewards. This issue arose during our response to Battle Pass errors after the 1.3.1 patch, and it was caused by inadequate handling by the Dev Team and an insufficient QA process. As the person in charge, I would like to apologize once again. We would like to assure you that we are continuously working to resolve the remaining issues.

Next, regarding the highly anticipated "Wall Crasher," we identified issues with reward drops at the beginning of the season, as well as unintended gameplay that exploited the party play function. We are currently preparing improvements for these issues.

We also humbly accept the feedback that Season 3 content as a whole has not met expectations in terms of stability and completeness. The Dev Team will do their utmost to address the remaining issues with urgency while ensuring the previously announced monthly update plans continue without delay.
In addition, the Dev Team aims to pursue more fundamental and sustainable improvements by learning from the issues that have emerged this season.
Above all, we plan to establish a more stable development environment by reorganizing inefficient internal processes that have accumulated since launch.

Not only will we make short-term efforts to prevent issues through more thorough inspections, but also, in the mid- to long-term, plan to comprehensively review and address problems within our inefficient development processes that have accumulated over time.
Through these efforts, we will do our best to develop faster and more stable response capabilities to provide updates that will better satisfy our Descendants.
While it may not fully make up for the disappointment our Descendants have felt regarding these issues, we have prepared the following compensation as a token of our sincerest apologies.
■ Compensation

Rewards will be delivered to your mailbox within approximately 10 minutes of logging in on the distribution date specified below.: ㄴ The Battle Pass EXP compensation will not be delivered through the Mailbox but will be automatically applied upon login. If it is not correctly applied, please try logging in again.

A total of 7 missions, including 2 new missions, have been added to Axion Plains.
New Missions: [table equalcells="1" colwidth=","]: New Mission: Strategic Asset Defense: New Mission: Decontamination
This new mission requires you to defend multiple objectives.
The more successfully you defend objectives, the faster the defense time decreases.
The mission will fail if you run out of attempts or all defended objectives are destroyed.
Decontamination is a new mission where you must defeat enemies to obtain Colossus Organic Samples and maintain a gauge until time runs out.

Field Data Transmitters are placed on the battlefield where the Decontamination mission takes place, and you can interact with them to interrupt the mission midway.: ㄴ You can't receive any mission completion rewards if you interrupt a mission by interacting with a Field Data Transmitter.

You can earn Kill Points by defeating Commanders that appear during the mission.: ㄴ You can receive rewards based on Commander Kill Points if you successfully complete a mission or interrupt a mission via interaction with a Field Data Transmitter.: ㆍ Defeating a Commander rewards 30 Void Abyss Metal Fragments and 10 Core Amplifiers.
The mission will fail if you run out of attempts or the gauge reaches 0.

Completing an Axion Plains mission will reward you with Descendant EXP, Weapon Proficiency EXP, Ironheart Particles, and Unique Arche Factor EXP. There is also a chance to obtain Blueprint Loot and Trigger Module Loot.: ㄴ From each Blueprint Loot, you can obtain one of the blueprints for crafting New Descendant: Nell, New Ultimate Weapon: ERASER, or New Vehicle: Orca or Vortex.: ㄴ For each Trigger Module Loot, you can obtain 1 of 9 Trigger Modules.

Rewards will be mailed to all Descendants who contributed to the Dimensional Energy Stabilization by clearing an Operational Area at least once.: ㄴ 1 Trigger Module Loot: ㄴ 1 Weapon Augmentation Core Box (1 Tier VII Core of every type): ㄴ 1 External Component Augmentation Core Box (1 Tier VII Core of every type): ㄴ 60 Specially Treated Alloys, 30 Insulating Nuts, 10 Alloy Bearings, 10 High Conductivity Wires

Trigger Modules that can only be equipped in the Trigger Module Slot will be added.: ㄴ Trigger Modules are modules that trigger an effect when the Descendant uses a skill.: ㆍ Some modules trigger based on the Descendant's skill tags, while others trigger when any skill is used.

Some Trigger Module options are acquired as random options.: ㄴ There are 3 tiers of random options.: ㆍ There are Common, Rare, and Ultimate tiers.: ㆍ The text color of the option name and values matches the color of the acquired tier.: ㄴ The tier is determined based on the acquired option values.: ㆍ The minimum to maximum values are displayed to the right of the option name.: ㄴ You can also check the tier of an acquired random option through the module icon.: ㄴ You can designate your favorite Trigger Modules.: ㆍ You can only designate your Attached Modules on the Trigger Module Settings screen.: ㆍ Modules designated as Attached are excluded from Trigger Module Dismantling.

Trigger Modules can be obtained by opening Trigger Module Loot.: ㄴ Trigger Module Loot can be obtained as rewards for Axion Plains missions, additional rewards from Operational Areas, rewards for defeating the Wall Crasher and Dimensional Energy Stabilization Reward.: ㆍ Chance to obtain as rewards for Axion Plains missions: 25%: ㆍ Chance to obtain as additional rewards from Axion Plains Operational Area: 25%: ㆍ Amount obtained as rewards for defeating the Wall Crasher: 4-22
Trigger Modules use a separate inventory from existing modules.: ㄴ If your Trigger Module inventory is full, you can find them in Lost and Found.
The Trigger Module Slot is saved together with existing Module loadouts and presets.

Trigger Modules can be dismantled but cannot be Enhanced or Combined.: ㄴ You can dismantle Trigger Modules via Silion in Albion.: ㆍ Available after completing the sub quest ‘Arche Trigger Unlock’.: ㆍ Dismantling a Trigger Module returns 30,000 Kuiper Shards.: ㄴ You can select all of your Trigger Modules for Dismantling using the Select All button.: ㆍ Equipped or Attached modules are excluded from Dismantling selection.
Implanting Module Settings includes Implanting the Trigger Module Slot.
You can check the list of Trigger Modules at the Modules section in the Library.: Trigger Modules

Dealing damage to an enemy with a Clash type skill causes an Earthquake that reduces the DEF of enemies in range proportional to the caster's DEF and inflicts damage and Taunt.: Arche Leak

Using a Continuous Damage type skill grants Arche Leak. While Arche Leak is active, hitting an enemy with a Continuous Damage skill consumes MP. The Skill Power Modifier increases proportionally to the difference between current MP and Max MP.
Recovers MP when using a Continuous Damage skill or each time an enemy is defeated by the Continuous Damage skill. Removes Arche Leak if there is no MP to consume.: Power Beyond
Using a Global DoT or a Ground DoT type skill grants Void Recharge.
Hitting an enemy while Void Recharge is at max stacks with a Global DoT or Ground DoT Skill creates an Amorphous Phenomenon under the enemy's feet and removes all Void Recharge stacks.
The Amorphous Phenomenon briefly inflicts Tow on enemies in range and reduces their ATK by a percentage of the Skill Range Boost Ratio.: Gap in Time
Hitting an enemy with a Normal AoE type skill deals Additional Damage.
Additional Damage Trigger Rate is inversely proportional to the caster's current Skill Cooldown Reduction.: Death by a Thousand Cuts
Using a Projectile type skill grants Residual Arche Preservation stacks based on the skill type.
Hitting an enemy with a Projectile type skill while Residual Arche Preservation is at max stacks causes an Arche Meteor to fall on the target and nearby enemies, dealing damage.
Residual Arche Preservation stacks differently for each Projectile type, with multi-type skills giving the most stacks.: Particle Conversion Emitter
Using an Ally Enhancement, Healing, Charging, or Supply type skill to grant a buff or heal an ally grants Particle Transmission to the ally.
Particle Transmission converts to Particle Emission at max stacks and deals Additional Damage proportional to the caster's Skill Power when attacking an enemy.
Particle Transmission does not apply while Particle Emission is active. Granting additional buff or healing a target affected by Particle Emission increases the duration.: Full Arche Jacket
When reloading, consume MP to grant the next magazine Arche Coating.
Arche Coating has a chance to deal Skill Damage to enemies near the target hit by your firearm until the magazine runs out.: Kuiper Hollow Points

Replaces bullets with Kuiper Hollow Points and increases Base Recoil. Hitting an enemy with a firearm anywhere other than a Weak Point.: grants Forced Weakening stacks to the caster based on the caster's Recoil Reduction Modifier.
Forced Weakening reduces Max HP while increasing Weak Point Damage per stack and removes some stacks and recovers HP on a successful Weak Point attack.
Changing weapons removes Forced Weakening. Effects do not trigger bullets that miss the target.: Cyclic Amplifier
Using a skill grant and rotates Cyclic Amplification, which increases the power of a single Arche attribute at regular intervals.: Skill Types

The new event consists of "Boost" and "Boost Path.": ㄴ Boost Period: After the 08.07.2025 (Thu) maintenance - 08.27.2025 (Wed) 23:59 PDT: ㄴ Boost Path Period: After the 08.07.2025 (Thu) maintenance - 09.17.2025 (Wed) 23:59 PDT
Boost can only be activated in Albion, and you can access it via the dedicated button on the Inventory screen.

Activating Boost completes all main quests on Normal Difficulty and unlocks Hard Difficulty. You will also receive various rewards shown below.: ㄴ A Level 40 Descendant Bunny with 2 assigned Module Socket Types and increased Max Capacity.: ㆍ Cannot be received if you already have Bunny.: ㆍ If your Bunny is below Level 40, has not had its Max Capacity increased, or has less than 2 assigned socket types, it will automatically be upgraded to the Bunny issued as a reward.: ㄴ The Ultimate Weapon Thunder Cage with 2 assigned Module Socket Types and increased Max Capacity.: ㄴ The Ultimate Weapon Secret Garden and the Rare Weapon Vestigial Organ.: ㄴ Various modules compatible with Bunny, Thunder Cage, and Secret Garden.: ㄴ An Ultimate Tier Reactor and 4 External Components.: ㄴ Energy Activators, Crystallization Catalysts, Descendant Slots, Gold, and Kuiper Shards.: ㄴ Items that maximize Descendant Level and Weapon Proficiency when used.

When activating Boost, you can choose between "Activate Boost" and "Claim Components Only," and the following differences apply depending on your choice.: ㄴ Activate Boost: ㆍ Recommended for new players.: ㆍ Your Descendant will automatically be replaced with Bunny, and modules will be automatically equipped.: ㆍ The weapons, Reactor, and External Components you receive will also be automatically equipped.: ㆍ The Junk Filter settings will automatically be changed.: ㆍ If the changed settings differ from your preferred settings, please make sure to change the settings back before use.: [table equalcells="1" colwidth=","]: Filter Type: Setting: Weapons: Weapon Tier: Ultimate or higher: Weapon Level: 100: Weapon with Enhanced Unique Ability: Exclude from Junk: Reactors: Reactor Tier: Ultimate or higher: Reactor Level: 100: Enhanced Reactor: Exclude from Junk: Option Filter Function: Yes: Number of Option Matches: Exclude if 2 or more are included: Option Tier: Rare or higher: External Components: External Component Tier: Ultimate or higher: External Component Level: 100: External Components with Set Effects: Include as Junk: External Components with Core: Exclude from Junk: Option Filter Function: Yes: Number of Option Matches: Exclude if 2 or more are included: Option Tier: Rare or higher: ㄴ Claim Components Only: ㆍ Recommended for existing players.: ㆍ All rewards are the same, but the Descendant and equipment will not automatically be changed.: ㆍ Equipped modules will not be changed, and the Junk Filter settings will also remain the same.

Boost Path: ㄴ Activating Boost unlocks the Boost Path.: ㄴ There are 11 categories in Boost Path, consisting of about 150 quests designed to help your introduction and growth in TFD.: ㄴ The Boost Path screen displays quest tips for each item. You can also access a quick and easy guide to the quest location using the "Go" button.: ㄴ Play Boost Paths to experience diverse Growth content and even get powerful rewards as shown below.: ㆍ You can acquire Ultimate Bunny and enhance it by assigning a Module Socket type.: ㆍ You can enhance Unique Abilities of Ultimate Weapon - Thunder Cage and assign extra Module Socket Types. You can also acquire Ultimate Weapon - Smithereens: ㆍ You can research the Fellow "Hagios Sheepdog" and the Descendants Sharen, Freyna, and Hailey. You can also acquire various rewards that help you develop your Descendants more efficiently.: ㄴ If you have previously completed a non-repeatable quest, it will be instantly marked as complete.: ㄴ If the status does not appear as completed even though the Descendant is equipped or replaced, please Unequip or Replace and the issue will be corrected.: ■ Patch 1.3.0: Content Improvements: (1) Content
Some of the in-quest interactive targets are changed to terminal or recording device.

Champion Monster Improvements: ㄴ Champion monsters in Special Operations no longer use Skill Interruption or MP Leech.: ㄴ Champion monsters no longer appear in Field Mission battles carried out with a Commander.: ㄴ Improved effect combinations of Champion Monsters appearing in Field Missions and Infiltration Operations.

Invasion > Order of Truth's hidden mechanics have been changed as follows: ㄴ The number of storage vessels has been reduced from four to one; All symbols are displayed on one vessel.: ㄴ The drone that marks the symbol do not move.: ㄴ Reduced the forced drone overload cooldown from 5 seconds to 3 seconds.: ㄴ Door will open automatically when the drone with the matching symbol is overloaded.: ㄴ Pickup Weapon (Inversion Energy Emitter) is now available in Commander battles only, not in common battles.: ㄴ Reduced the Pickup Weapon (Inversion Energy Emitter) hit for cancelling Commander's Immunity to one hit.: ㄴ Increased the Magazine Capacity of Pickup Weapon (Inversion Energy Emitter) to 99 loads.: ㄴ Shortened some routes in White-night Gulch Mystery's End and Heart of the Fortress Invasion.: ㄴ Added a guide video to the beginning of a Mission to help players' understanding of how to progress in Invasion plays. Each Guide video will be played once per account.
Clearing of No Resurrection Zone in Invasions: ㄴ Resurrection limit in Commander Battle areas in all Invasions has been cleared. Players can now resurrect at where they die during Commander Battles.

Registration of Target Reward unit has been changed from by acquisition source to item.

When an item is registered as Target Reward, you can accumulate Target Reward Progress in any content that offers the item as a reward.: ㄴ Example: ㆍ Previous: Register "Item A / Void Vessel" as Target Reward > Progress accumulates when playing Void Vessel: ㆍ Changed: Register "Item A" as Target Reward > Progress accumulates when playing any content (e.g., Void Vessel, Intercept Battle, Missions, etc.) that offers the item as a reward

Target Reward Progress accumulates by 1/n by the number of effective Target Rewards when playing a content.: ㄴ Example: ㆍ If the progress gauge for A and B are 50 and 30, respectively, in a content: ㆍ Previous: Get 50 for A and / 30 for B: ㆍ Changed: Get 25 for A and / 15 for B: (4) UI & UX

■ Platforms
Steam, XBOX SERIES X│S, PS5: ■ Update 1.2.20: Additional External Component Cores
"External Component Cores" that enhance the performances of External Components have been added.
External Components of "Ultimate" Tier or higher have theirs Core unlocked and do not require Core Unlocking.
You may equip External Component Cores by using Albion's "Core Crafting Bench" once reaching Mastery Rank 8.
Crafting and conversion of existing Cores are not available at "Core Crafting Bench" once you reach Mastery Rank 8.

All External Components have two Core Slots and each of them have assigned Augment Types.: ㄴ You can only equip a Core Slot with the same Augment type of External Component Core Items, and options are granted once it's equipped.

Options for each External Component Core Augment type are as follows: [table equalcells="1" colwidth=",,"]: Augment Type: Core: Grantable Options: [td rowspan="5"]: Recovery Augmentation: [td rowspan="2"]: Recovery Augmentation Core: Max HP: HP Recovery Modifier: [td rowspan="3"]: Recovery Augmentation Core (Variant AB): Max Shield: Shield Recovery Out of Combat: Shield Recovery In Combat: [td rowspan="6"]: Defense Augmentation: [td rowspan="3"]: DEF Augmentation Core: DEF: Fire Resistance: Chill Resistance: [td rowspan="3"]: DEF Augmentation Core (Variant AB): DEF: Electric Resistance: Toxin Resistance
External Components of Ultimate tier of higher can equip External Component Cores.: ㄴ When an External Component Core is equipped, a random option is granted per the Augment type.

External Component Core items have stages, marked with Roman numerals (e.g., I, II, III, etc.). The higher the stage, the better the option effect values they provide.: ㄴ Each option has a fixed value range based on the External Component Core item's stage, and the final value is randomly determined within that range.

An External Component Core that is equipped to a Core Slot may be replaced with another one.: ㄴ To change an External Component Core, a "Core Particle Disruptor" item is required, just as for a Weapon Core.: ㄴ When replacing an External Component Core, you may choose from the existing effects and the new effects. If you do not like the new effects, choose to keep the existing one.: ㄴ If you decide to keep the existing effects, the External Component Core and Core Particle Disruptor spent for the replacement are not returned.
You may craft External Component Cores at a Core Crafting Bench.: ㄴ To craft an External Component Core, a "Core Amplifier" is needed, just as for a Weapon Core.
You may convert External Component Cores at a Core Crafting Bench.: ㄴ You may convert Stage 10 External Component Cores, just as for Weapon Cores.

External Component Core items can be acquired from the "400% Infiltration Operation" and "Sigma Sector Dropoff Operation.": ㄴ Sigma Sector Dropoff Operation Normal Stage 1-8: ㄴ Infiltration Operation: Hard 400% Stage 2-10: ㄴ Sigma Sector Dropoff Operation High-risk Stage 3-10: Additional Weapon Core
"Hit Augmentation Core (Variant AB)" that can be equipped to a Weapon's Hit Augmentation Slot has been added.

You can choose to equip or replace the existing "Hit Augmentation Core" or the new "Hit Augmentation Core (Variant AB)" to the Hit Augmentation Slot.: ㄴ You can replace an existing Core equipped to a slot with a "Hit Augmentation Core (Variant AB)," and vice versa.

"Hit Augmentation Core (Variant AB)" can be crafted and converted.: [table equalcells="1" colwidth=",,"]: Augment Type: Core: Grantable Options: [td rowspan="3"]: Hit Augmentation: [td rowspan="3"]: Hit Augmentation Core (Variant AB: Weak Point DMG: Multi-Hit Chance: Multi-Hit Damage

Hit Augmentation Core (Variant AB) can be acquired from Void Erosion Purge, just as other Weapon Cores.: ㄴ Hit Augmentation Cores (Variant AB) with different Stages have been added to Mission Completion Rewards.: ㄴ The chance to acquire the existing Weapon Cores by defeating Normal/Commander monsters remains unchanged. You can now acquire Hit Augmentation Cores (Variant AB) additionally.: ㄴ As for Void Erosion Purge: Challenge Difficulty, Hit Augmentation Core (Variant AB) was not added as its reward as many Descendants have already acquired rewards.: Void Intercept Battle: Challenge
Void Intercept Battle: Challenge has been added. Colossus appearing in the Challenge difficulty are much more formidable.
Void Intercept Battle: Challenge features Ice Maiden. To intercept this Ice Maiden, you must clear "The Most Powerful Colossus Intercept Battle" Quest first.
Void Intercept Battle: Challenge only supports private matchmaking.

Rewards: [table equalcells="1" colwidth=""]: Rewards: 600 Quality Certified ETA Vouchers: 7 Types of Weapon Augmentation Core, 20 each (140 in total): \[Firepower, Attribute, Hit, Tactical, Precision, and Specialized, and Hit Variant AB]: 800 Core Amplifiers: ㄴ Rewards can only be earned once for the first clear of the intercept battle.: ㆍ When the appearing Colossus changes, you may earn rewards again.: ㄴ Rewards are sent directly to your Inventory. releases.displayName: Content Availability Adjustment Due to Season 3 Update

items.text: Greetings, Descendants.
Due to the rescheduling of the Season 3 update to Thursday, August 7, the availability periods of content originally set to reset or end with the next season will also be adjusted accordingly.
Please refer to the details below regarding the content with updated availability periods:
■ Battle Pass

releases.displayName: 2025 Skin Contest Submission Extension & Award Criteria Update

items.text: Greetings, Descendants!
The submission period for the 2025 Skin Contest, which began on May 12 (Mon), has been extended to allow for greater participation and creativity.
We hope this change will give all Descendants more time to finalize and submit their designs.
In addition, the award criteria for Descendant skins have been updated.
Instead of selecting finalists by gender categories (Men / Women / Unisex), all Descendant skin entries will now be reviewed under a unified selection format.
This update aims to reduce the burden on participants and encourage a wider range of creative submissions.
Please note that we have identified several entries that do not follow the official submission guidelines.

To be considered, entries must be submitted using the official template. Submissions consisting solely of screenshots or standalone illustrations without the template will not be eligible for finalist selection.
Please refer to the details below for full information on the schedule changes and award updates.
■ Updated Event Schedule
■ Award Criteria Changes
If the number of submissions or qualified entries is limited, the number of finalists and winners may vary by category (Descendant / Fellow).
If no entries meet the minimum finalist criteria in a specific category, no finalists may be selected for that category.: ■ Submission Guidelines
Please download the appropriate template based on the skin category you are entering and follow the instructions. [Download Template]

Submissions that include only screenshots or standalone images without the template will not be considered for finalist selection.: We look forward to your creative participation in the 2025 Skin Contest.: Thank you.

The Void Intercept Battle: Abyss Leaderboard has been changed to Ice Maiden. ㄴ The Void Intercept Battle: Abyss Leaderboard will be reset as follows: ㄴ Reset Start Time: After the 05.22.2025 (Thu) maintenance - 06.18.2025 145959 PDT - The Ice Maiden Descendant skin, “The Frozen One,” and the Colotoys “Ice Maiden” Back Attachment have been added to the ETA-0 Shop. ㄴ The previously available Tormentor Descendant skin, “Pain Giver,” and the Colotoys “Tormentor” Back Attachment will also remain available for exchange throughout this season’s episode period.: [table equalcells="1" colwidth=""]: # Director’s Comments To improve gameplay styles of Void Abyss Intercept Battle that ends in under 1 second and reward structure that requires excessive repetitions, we implemented the following changes: First, the play time was adjusted in consideration of the extremely short battle duration that prevented strategic gameplays. With this adjustment, we aimed to bring out the necessity to employ attribute-based battle strategies. Ice Maiden, especially, was designed to have a structure that shortens the clear time as players destroy its parts and gradually enhance the Descendant’s Skill Power. Next, we heard your opinion of the low multi-player battle efficiency and adjusted the HP and Shield multipliers that was applied to 4-player rounds from 3.2 times to 2 times. With this adjustment, we expect our players to enjoy faster and more meaningful gameplay experiences in multi-player modes. As the battle duration will increase, we also adjusted the reward efficiency. Rewards have been adjusted to require less attempts to be acquired to ease the burden of repetitive plays, and we made adjustments to offer more customizable items. However, to ensure the existing growth-oriented rewards, you will be able to exchange some of the growth rewards with Quality Certified ETA Voucher. We will continue to make detailed adjustments to Intercept Battles so that you can enjoy tactical gameplays and the joy of defeating formidable enemies with other players.: Recruit/Join Party - Party tab has been added to the right side of Social tab. - You can recruit Party Members that meet your requirements or you can join a Party. - Party Recruitment Conditions ㄴ You can configure the party recruitment condition at Recruit Party menu and recruit Party Members. ㄴ Use Settings button to apply the recruitment condition.: [table equalcells="1" colwidth=",,"]: Condition: Description: Mastery Rank

You can instantly join a Party that meets your requirements.: Weapon - Multi-Hit Chance and Multi-Hit Damage options have been added to Weapon Options. - Changes were made to allow set individual Module Loadout setting for each weapon if you have many of the same Weapon. ㄴ When saving a preset, if you have more than one the same Weapon equipped, each Weapon’s Module Loadout setting will be saved individually. ㄴ The Weapon Module Loadout number that is applied to each Weapon will be displayed in the Inventory and Weapon Tooltip.: [table equalcells="1" colwidth=""]: # Director’s Comments Thank you for giving us lots of feedback on potential additions to Multi-Hit Core. We decided on this development based on feedback from players. We listened to various opinions on how we should implement the Multi-Hit Chance and Damage stats into the Cores. The most popular suggestion was to add them to Special Augmentation, followed by suggestions to put them in Hit Augmentation. We felt it would be more appropriate to include them in the family of Hit Augmentations so that Multi-Hit could become a competitive option alongside Critical Hit. However, we also had to consider that increasing the number of Hit Augmentation Core stats to five would make it harder to get the desired stats. Accordingly, we opted to keep the existing Cores unchanged and added a new Hit Augmentation AB Core instead. This Core can be equipped in the Hit Augmentation slot, and consists of three stats: Multi-Hit Chance, Multi-Hit Damage, and Weak Point Damage. This update will be rolled out on June 19 together with the External Component Core update, and we’ll continue to closely consider your feedback as we proceed with updates.: Leaderboard Ranking Reward - Added ranking rewards to the Void Erosion Purge: Challenge Leaderboard. - Rewards will be mailed when the leaderboard resets, based on your rank at that point. - You will need to reconnect to the game to receive the mail, and as the mails are sent sequentially, players may receive their reward at varying times. - Rewards ㄴ Eligibility: 1st to 100th place in all platform combined Solo Rankings ㄴ Reward: Ingris Prime Challenger Medal (limited-time) ㄴ Period of use: 06-19-2025 001959 (PDT) - until the end of season episode - In the Solo category, the rankings are aggregated for each Descendant, and even if you have multiple Descendants placed in the reward eligible rankings (1st to 100th), you’ll only receive the reward for the highest-ranked Descendant. - Currently, there are no rewards for the rankings by platform or 2-/3-/4-player squad rankings. Unlocks upon clearing Void Erosion Purge: Normal Difficulty .: How to Access
You can access it via the Infiltration Operations Terminal or the Void Erosion Purge: Challenge icon on the World Map.: How to Play
Void Erosion Purge: Challenge consists of 5 stages.
Players start at stage 1 and the rest of the stages are locked.

After starting Erosion Purge, you'll need to defeat the Vulgus Legion to fill the target gauge. When the gauge is full, the final Commander will appear. Defeat the Commander to complete the Void Erosion Purge.
Complete Erosion Purge within the target time to unlock the next stage.: Determination of Outcome
Erosion Purge Complete: If you complete the mission within the target time of 12 minutes, you will receive the mission completion rewards and unlock the next stage.
Mission Complete: If you complete the mission but exceed the target time of 12 minutes, you will receive the mission completion rewards but the next stage won't be unlocked.
Mission Failed: If you fail to complete the mission and exceed all 15 minutes of playtime, you will not receive the mission completion rewards and the next stage won't be unlocked.: Rewards
Only Rounds, MP and HP items drop from the Vulgus Legion that appear, and you cannot obtain other items, Descendant EXP or Firearm Proficiency from defeating them.
Tier X Cores and Weapon Core Amplifiers are available as one-time rewards the first time you complete the Erosion Purge mission.: Public Operation Availability
